| It's Caucus Time!
---
|

Friend,
Caucus week is upon us and is happening all across Colorado! We hope you plan to participate in the process. You may Pre-Register [HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ecr2PJQbVhpl9W5EmivnxVRhh6gjGHLTlEF1Ljro8d45iUekzunGc3Q7EYinByqHlKxlXuJFJHBypwxDo3lWAWnhG-NqSwCzJsb-1IeaVspBPn8LN8GRX3UMHpCm8wZDRzWJ1j-mAC5QjOYRz6yaGg==&c=4gFdukHS3GHsbxkDVQeTqgTt_yWpVm-y3l1AatPHvLzpKn8oy8utZw==&ch=DIJ9JHhzY-UCbNW7wSDD3AKjpiouLo9H0FDma_gHIsMxo6EbTnDe1w==).
---
| |
---
Your county is holding Caucus on Tuesday, March 1 unless otherwise listed below:
---
---
| | [Find Your County GOP Website HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001ecr2PJQbVhpl9W5EmivnxVRhh6gjGHLTlEF1Ljro8d45iUekzunGc3Q7EYinByqHp7HcZ0kKSOe3nctKWpBq2DVphnkfg1W43j9PJwMwmr7SKdWscEGuC5c5Gg9oL1upKO9OSyACrWp4A1WjWgqFGXYW4WvIO2NO7E6w92nn7zk=&c=4gFdukHS3GHsbxkDVQeTqgTt_yWpVm-y3l1AatPHvLzpKn8oy8utZw==&ch=DIJ9JHhzY-UCbNW7wSDD3AKjpiouLo9H0FDma_gHIsMxo6EbTnDe1w==)
---
| |
---
Why Should I Attend Caucus?
---
At Caucus, you will become a Precinct Committee Person (PCP) who:
* Works Local Neighborhoods for Get Out The Vote (GOTV).
* Votes on Party Bylaw Changes.
* Elects District Captains.
* Elects County Party Officers.
* Elect to become a County Delegate.

---
| |
---
Why Should I Attend County Assembly on March 19th?
---
As a County Delegate at Assembly you will be able to:
* Vote on which County-wide Candidate appears on the June Primary Ballot.
* Vote on various resolutions to be added to the State Party Platform.
* Elect to become a State Delegate (4,743) or Alternates (4,738).

---
| |
---
Why Should I Attend State Assembly on April 9th?
---
As a State Delegate, you will be able to:
* Vote for Candidates for Secretary of State, State Treasurer, Attorney General, At-Large State Board of Education, U.S. Senate, and
* Most Importantly...

...Vote for Greg Lopez to be your Governor Candidate in the June Primary to face and defeat Jared Polis in November!
---
| |
---
Be the change we have been waiting for. Become a delegate and vote for the best conservative candidates at all office levels including me, Greg Lopez, for Governor!
---
---
|
---
To win Colorado, it's going to take all of us chipping

| David just delivered a strong message at CPAC: **The liberal Democrat agenda has totally failed, and conservatives have to unite to take back our country.**

Watch David's speech [**HERE**](https://davidperduega.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1eaf1761f5031bae92fd4e677&id=325a0a6196&e=89fb4d5220). [](https://davidperduega.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1eaf1761f5031bae92fd4e677&id=c278780a75&e=89fb4d5220) _**Highlights:**_

"If self-determination and freedom are going to abound and flourish in the rest of the world, we have to defend it here at home."

"We have a fight right now in my home state. ... There are a group of people in Buckhead who actually just want to have a vote to determine how they’re going to be governed. I believe they should have a vote. Don’t you?"

"If you want to stop the Biden madness, go vote. If you want to fix the elections, go vote. ... We have that opportunity."

"If we pull together, we can make darn sure the Democrats never turn our beloved America into a socialist state."

Thanks for all you do,
Team Perdue

| | Team 11 is working to keep America's promise to Afghans
---
| |
---
| | The last remaining U.S. troops departed Afghanistan August 30, 2021. An estimated 124,000 citizens had been airlifted out of the country by that date, according to the Biden administration. It was a tumultuous scene seared in the minds of so many onlookers from around the world that ostensibly ended America’s 20-year occupation of the region. Many were happy to see military service members come home and the war conclude. The worst appeared over for the U.S., but the atrocities Afghan citizens had experienced for two decades could not be undone. Worse yet, those remaining in Afghanistan were now staring down the barrel of brutal oppression and persecution at the hands of the Islamic State. Among those trapped in the country are countless Afghans who devoted years assisting U.S. troops with vital tasks such as bomb detection or translation services. The tragedy of Afghanistan cannot be overstated. Blame can be placed at the feet of many powerful people, including both Republican and Democratic presidents. Biden, to his credit, ended years of buck-passing and made good on his word to withdraw troops. The withdrawal itself was hardly a success, however. The U.S.’s antiquated, onerous Special Immigrant Visa (SIV) program let thousands slip through the cracks. Finally, at least 200 Afghans and 13 American military personnel were killed when an Islamic State extremist detonated a bomb at Hamid Karzai Airport on August 26. In the face of many failures made by our government over many years, a range of former military personnel and every day Americans are attempting to help where bureaucrats have failed. One of the most notable examples, which we hope to bring attention to during Doug’s campaign for Congress, is Save Team 11. Elinor Kasza, mother to one of the U.S. Army Special Forces members who founded [Save Team 11](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/5bNyzoxmo/c?w=UxX2I8lraRIkTmL6wuA-s3IPHBzuAomwgCumBBNpBlQ.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuY2hhbmdlLm9yZy9wL3VzLXN0YXRlLWRlcGFydG1lbnQtc2F2ZS10ZWFtLTExIiwiciI6ImEwNTAwNTlkLWM5YzctNDJjNS05OWU5LTNlMGZhMTc1NWQxNiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjA0OTZmZmUwLWMwYmEtNDYwNi05OTg2LWMyODAzN2U4ZDE1NSJ9), reached out to Doug White’s campaign recently and we are honored to be able to share her story.
The non-profit organization’s namesake, Team 11, is a group of Afghan soldiers who worked side-by-side with Tom Kasza’s U.S. Special Forces team. For years Team 11 saved American lives through their expertise in identifying and disarming improvised explosive devices. Notwithstanding the members’ devotion to keeping U.S. personnel alive, most Team 11 members haven’t made it out of Afghanistan. Our government owes people like Team 11 a guarantee of safety, if nothing else. Kasza’s group, Save Team 11, is largely focused on pressuring the U.S. State Department to reform and expedite the SIV process. [As Doug has written previously](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/5bNyzoxmo/c?w=IZc1c7YW9bEL5WyvGGe2RyCe9zqQ3ElwK26DgkHZiyY.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZG91Z3doaXRlNGNvbmdyZXNzLnVzL3Zpc2lvbiIsInIiOiJhMDUwMDU5ZC1jOWM3LTQyYzUtOTllOS0zZTBmYTE3NTVkMTYiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIwNDk2ZmZlMC1jMGJhLTQ2MDYtOTk4Ni1jMjgwMzdlOGQxNTUifQ), our immigration system sorely needs change, and the abandonment of Team 11 members is just one more example why.Team 11 is comprised of Hazaras — an ethnic minority that faces an even greater threat from the Taliban. Kasza’s campaign has crowdfunded enough money to feed and house them this winter, the group says the need for more resources is “dire”. We ask of those who can, to consider [donating to Save Team 11](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/5bNyzoxmo/c?w=iIpnnIrYfG2gXDvYn4r8_M7pA4Gh866eNcvT_nvA488.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZ29mdW5kbWUuY29tL2Yvc2F2ZXRlYW0xMT91dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249cF9jcCtzaGFyZS1zaGVldCZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWNvcHlfbGlua19hbGwmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1jdXN0b21lciIsInIiOiJhMDUwMDU5ZC1jOWM3LTQyYzUtOTllOS0zZTBmYTE3NTVkMTYiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIwNDk2ZmZlMC1jMGJhLTQ2MDYtOTk4Ni1jMjgwMzdlOGQxNTUifQ)’s campaign to protect these selfless individuals and make lasting change in our country’s immigration policies. For too long the U.S. government has failed to protect those who protected our troops. It is my belief there is perhaps no more deserving group than the Hazara members of Team 11. With the help of caring citizens like you, Save Team 11 can help our country live up to its obligations and harbor these heroes from the predations of the Taliban. We are honored to be able to use the Doug White 4 Congress campaign to bring attention to this harrowing story.

subject: Heartfelt thanks...and one more request!
body:
The Primary is Tuesday! I want to thank you so much for your support and make one more request. | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/ce54cc9a0e7a/volunteers-needed-trump-rally-and-lake-conroe-boat-show-15920078?e=82b2b364e3)
---
| | |
---
| | |
# Greetings Dan McKaughan for Texas Team!!

I want to thank you once again for supporting me in my race to represent Texas' 8th Congressional District. The district runs from Katy to Cypress, Magnolia to Willis, and on through Coldspring to Corrigan. Yes, it is a large district, and we’ve done our best to reach the voters. But now is the critical time where I need your help to spread the word!

The primary election is Tuesday, March 1st. That's just a couple days away. So I ask each of you to please copy the paragraph below (in _italics_) and forward it on to your friends, family, neighbors, and business associates who live in the 8th District. Usually around 50% of the primary voters vote on election day, so if each of you send it to your mailing list, you will greatly help me get the votes I need to save our country. (You might want to BCC everyone so you don't make all the email addresses public.) We must get the voters out. This primary is one of the most important in our history, as we get to choose who we will send to D.C. to represent us and fight for the preservation of our Liberty.

_Dear friends and neighbors:

The primary election on Tuesday, March 1st to put our candidate on the November ballot is the most critical in our history. We say that every election, but this time around, I feel it might actually be true. We have a choice to make: tyranny.....or liberty. I proudly support Dan McKaughan, a U.S. Naval Academy graduate, retired Naval Lt. Commander, and small business VP who I know will take our Texas values to Washington. He is not beholden to any D.C. special interest or the establishment. And he never will be. Dan is a true conservative and a true patriot. He will fight to restore and protect our American freedoms and return our Republic to its Constitutional roots. I urge you to vote on Tuesday, March 1st for Dan McKaughan and tell your friends and neighbors as well. I know he will serve us honorably. _

Feel free to modify that as you see fit.

Also, one more thing. If you are free on Tuesday and would like to man a polling site and give voters one last look at me, let me know. We'll tell you where you can go and get you information.

Peace,

Dan

**We’re 2 days away from the Primary!!!**

[http://danmckaughan.com](https://DanMcKaughan.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3546b09b826f568403b576872&id=6b27008247&e=82b2b364e3)

#whocandancan #constituentsovercash

Super-charged vaccine distribution
Lower taxes for middle class families
Higher wages and incomes

body:

This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zg9cs29qj9chpidqb7lt2ser5la229b7gnj1t4bo_rp22sh2s8i66ob3c1gm9or2chh2bs)
---
| |
Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don’t know his full story—especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons.

King David’s momentous story provides profound insights into many of life’s most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **“The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King”** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David’s character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel.
---
| | **This is why we’ve produced our online course, “The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King,” which is now available on DVD. And you can reserve your copy using this secure link:**

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/david-story-dvd](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z79luqe3vrpadt85gpptaviom23fniietend98e0_rp22sh2s8i66ob3c1gm9or2chh2bs)** By viewing the course, you’ll learn more about the nature of God, family, leadership, sin, and repentance; in short, you’ll learn more about what truly matters in life. **I hope you’ll reserve your DVD today and share its abiding lessons with your family and friends. The DVD is perfect for a Bible study or homeschool curriculum.**
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zaqulcdktfq8domsc6nqtioqjevln0los38kiopg_rp22sh2s8i66ob3c1gm9or2chh2bs)
---
| | Let’s learn what truly matters in life by studying **“The David Story.”**

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

**P.S.** If you’d like to secure a DVD box set of **“The David Story”** while they’re available, you can have one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more in support of reaching and teaching millions on behalf of liberty.

Reserve your DVD box set using the secure link below:

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/david-story-dvd](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z7lh4sa83ue5targ3u7br4e1a3fb75jern1vgfhg_rp22sh2s8i66ob3c1gm9or2chh2bs)**

subject: The USA Freedom Convoy is coming
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Great American Patriot Project
body:
March 2nd we’re hitting the road. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6713%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=mJ3T7fMynagzyC4RTKSUqA&sysid=1)
---
| | | | | | | | [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69141%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=TgHYsk43CXvEDyQ7pvb8yA&sysid=1)
---
| | |
Friend,

I’m writing to you with very exciting news. Just like our neighbors to the North in Canada, America’s truckers are fed up with the unscientific and unconstitutional government overreach we’ve endured over the past two years, _and we’re taking action._

**That’s right, a Freedom Convoy driving from California to Washington, D.C. is beginning on March 2nd!** **_[SUPPORT THE CONVOY](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69142%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=hMkHaFG3IjByv9JLGR%2fjTA&sysid=1 "SUPPORT THE
CONVOY")_**
We’ve had enough. Vaccine mandates, mask mandates, lockdowns, and restrictions have all failed to stop the spread of the virus. **As we all know, it stopped being about the virus a long time ago, it’s just about control and power. **

When Justin Trudeau announced he was using terrorism laws to freeze the bank accounts of peaceful protestors in Ottawa without due process, **_HE DIDN’T MENTION COVID ONCE!!!_**

These same tyrannical, thuggish tactics will come to America if we don’t stand up and say ENOUGH IS ENOUGH, **_[which is why we’re asking you to join us by making a secure donation on our independent fundraising platform.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69143%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5o7d3Ft74XS%2ff9nEZwBLFQ&sysid=1 "which is why we’re asking
you to join us by making a secure donation on our independent fundraising
platform. ")_**

Your money will go directly to paying for fuel and food for the brave Truckers in the Freedom Convoy. With gas prices skyrocketing under Joe Biden, fuel for the cross country trip is $5,000 per Big Rig!
**_[$15 = 10 Miles](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69144%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=bqz6EKnHnxApi%2bUwkvONeA&sysid=1 "$15 = 10 Miles")_**
**_[$30 = 20 Miles](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69255%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7pZuyEfOpdFHeqzDQLYFIg&sysid=1 "$30 = 20 Miles")_**
**_[$150 = 100 Miles](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69256%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=rWLqA0MzwDepKeOkGDmENg&sysid=1 "$150 = 100 Miles")_**
**_[$375 = 250 Miles](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69257%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=yvh12jNItMqBaXORh17%2fRA&sysid=1 "$375 = 250 Miles")_**
**_[$750 = 500 Miles](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69258%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ju7s6P%2bXFx%2fmBRWxivtcrQ&sysid=1 "$750 = 500 Miles")
[$1,500 = 1,000 Miles](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69259%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xMbAGE2p0HAzAN%2bItJqspw&sysid=1 "$1,500 = 1,000
Miles")_**
We the Truckers, and We the People, have had enough of the creeping tyranny, and we’re putting our lives on hold and our livelihoods on the line to get our Freedom back.

**_[So, I hope you’ll join us as we embark upon this great journey with a generous gift of any amount.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c69250%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=DJT1O3hnKyajhhPLsG6bdw&sysid=1 "So, I hope you’ll join us
as we embark upon this great journey with a generous gift of any amount.")_**

In Liberty,

Truckers for Freedom

body:
www.ashleywardforcongress.com [www.ashleywardforcongress.com]
Weekly Updates
WHAT A WEEK!
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93808/images/2022%20Interim%20Congressional%20%281%29.png]
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93808/images/2022_NC04_Map.jpg] We finally have maps! The big news this week is that the NC courts finalized our Congressional map. We are NC04, which includes Alamance, Durham, Granville, Orange, and Person Counties.
I have strong roots in this district. My family has lived in Durham for nearly 100 years, first migrating as sharecroppers to work in the tobacco factories. I was born in Durham and lived there until I was 13, when I moved with my mother to Person County. I am a proud graduate from Person High and Piedmont Community College. My husband, Lynn Ward, is a 30-year teaching veteran in Person county. After we were married, we moved to Orange County for work and school opportunities for me. I returned to school and graduated from UNC-Chapel Hill. I've lived in Durham, Orange, and Person counties and currently have family in Durham, Alamance, and Granville Counties.
It is a great honor to run for office in a district that means so much to me.
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93808/images/Filing1.jpg] [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93808/images/Filing2.jpg]
I also officially filed for office! As I did so, I was thinking of my grandmothers. Sue and Betty had 3rd and 9th grade educations. I wonder what they would think to see their granddaughter, a PhD, and now a candidate for Congress. They always told me, "If you want things to be different, then you DO different." I think they were right.
WHAT'S NEXT?
We are 12 weeks from the primary!
This means that it is time for a big push to get my name and message out. This also means we have some upcoming expenses. With FIVE counties i n my district, it is more important than ever to invest in the materials we need to spread the word about my campaign. For example, here are some of our immediate upcoming expenses:
10,000 Postcard Mailers with Postage: $4735
3,000 Yard Signs: $4339
Billboard: $5000
Any donation you can make that will help us with these materials would be greatly appreciated. Every donation counts in a grassroots campaign like mine!
SUPPORT ASHLEY'S CAMPAIGN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/friends-of-ashley-ward-1]
IMPORTANT DATES
EARLY VOTING: April 28th - May 14th
PRIMARY DAY: May 17th
FIND YOUR POLLING PLACE [https://vt.ncsbe.gov/pplkup/]
GET INVOLVED
EVENT ALERT:
Wednesday, March 9th
6pm-9pm
Churton Grove Clubhouse,
1616 Ainsworth Blvd, Hillsborough, NC 27278.
Join us for wine, cheese, and hors d'oeuvres to write postcards, staple walk cards, and fellowship with other volunteers. These are great fun!
I hope to see you there!
RSVP [ashley@ashleywardforcongress.com?subject=Volunteer%20Event%20RSVP&body=]
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93808/images/Virtual%20Meet%26Greet%20Instagram%20%282%29.png]
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93808/images/Canvass2_2.jpg] [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93808/images/IMG_7931.jpg]
It was another great weekend out in the community. Our campaign has such wonderful, dedicated volunteers - they even come out and canvass in the rain!
If you'd like to get involved, consider joining us for a Lit Drop. A lit drop is distributing literature. It is no-contact, so COVID safe, and takes about 2 hours. We are out with volunteers every Saturday and Sunday!
You can also sign up to write postcards. We have thousands of postcards to write so we can do outreach to the areas of the district that are hard to reach with lit drops.
And finally, I hope you'll consider hosting an in-person or virtual event. These are a great way to introduce me to your friends, neighbors, and colleagues.
LIT DROP [https://www.signupgenius.com/go/10c0f44aeaa22a6ffc43-litdrop] POSTCARDS [ashley@ashleywardforcongress.com?subject=PostCards&body=Hi%20Ashley%21%20I%27d%20like%20to%20write%20postcards.%20Tell%20me%20how%20to%20get%20involved%21] HOST EVENT [ashley@ashleywardforcongress.com?subject=Host%20an%20Event&body=Hi%20Ashley%21%20I%27d%20like%20to%20host%20an%20event%21%20Let%20me%20know%20how%20I%20can%20get%20involved.]
CAMPAIGN T-SHIRTS!
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93808/images/IMG_2345.png]
“Made in North Carolina from Dirt to Shirt!” from TS Designs.
TS Designs uses cotton grown in North Carolina, shirts are preshrunk, and use water-based inks. I am thrilled to work with a company committed to sustainability. Just like me, these shirts are “Made in NC!”
Donate $20 today and get your t-shirt. Minimum $20 donation required (shipping included). Limited quantities and colors available. Colors may vary slightly.
ORDER T-SHIRT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/arwardtshirts]
YARD SIGNS ARE HERE!
image of ... [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93808/images/Yard%20Sign%20%287%29.png]
Yard signs are an effective way to get word out about my campaign. We need as many folks as possible to show their support and put a yard sign in their yard! Pick one up for you and your neighbor!
REQUEST A YARD SIGN [https://ashleywardforcongress.com/yard-sign]

name: Abby Finkenauer
subject: Trip down memory lane!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Abby for Iowa Abby for Iowa
body:
My parents couldn't give me a trust fund or debt-free college, but what they taught me was so much more valuable ...
| | |
---
It's funny to think about how different my life was when this photo was taken – and how much is still the same as we build up this campaign to defeat Sen. Chuck Grassley (R-IA). Back then, all I knew was my small town of Sherrill in rural Iowa – around 200 people, five churches, a bar, a post office and a school.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42336972/332589596/805649176?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk710-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MzU5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NWU4ZGUzYi05Yjk4LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=T9QUQh85SIKP9Jx6c1Z7L0hixbx-Ia_wx_pFhiVHki0=)
I was raised in a working class family – my dad was a union pipe-fitter welder and my mom worked in the public school system. My parents couldn't give me a trust fund or debt-free college, but what they taught me was so much more valuable: **how to treat people with respect; to never think you’re better than anyone else; and that when there is work to be done or a problem to solve, you say “yes.”**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42336973/332589597/805649176?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk710-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MzU5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NWU4ZGUzYi05Yjk4LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=T9QUQh85SIKP9Jx6c1Z7L0hixbx-Ia_wx_pFhiVHki0=)
**That's why, when my community needed a fighter in the Iowa State House, I stepped up and won my first election at only 25.** I served for four years in the State House, and I fought hard to deliver for my constituents – one night, I kept the House in session until midnight to demand equal pay for women.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42336974/332589598/805649176?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk710-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MzU5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NWU4ZGUzYi05Yjk4LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=T9QUQh85SIKP9Jx6c1Z7L0hixbx-Ia_wx_pFhiVHki0=)
I was proud to serve in the State House, but the work didn't stop there for me. **That's why I decided to run for Congress and became the youngest woman to flip a House seat from red to blue.** Then, after just two weeks in Congress and during a government shutdown, I became the youngest woman to pass a bill through the House of Representatives with my legislation to create more opportunities for rural America.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42336975/332589599/805649176?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk710-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MzU5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NWU4ZGUzYi05Yjk4LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=T9QUQh85SIKP9Jx6c1Z7L0hixbx-Ia_wx_pFhiVHki0=)
**My story is about service, community and understanding the value of hard work.** That's why I'm running to defeat Sen. Chuck Grassley (R-IA) – to give working families a real fighter in the Senate. Right now, he's facing RECORD-LOW approval with Iowa voters, so we've got the best chance in decades to flip this seat blue and expand Democrats' Senate majority. **[We simply cannot win without major grassroots support, so will you rush a donation of $5 or more now to seize this momentum, defeat Sen. Grassley and expand our Senate majority?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42336976/332589600/805649176?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk710-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MzU5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NWU4ZGUzYi05Yjk4LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=T9QUQh85SIKP9Jx6c1Z7L0hixbx-Ia_wx_pFhiVHki0=)**
I know that defeating Sen. Grassley won't be a walk in the park. **However, I've had plenty of people tell me that I was too young or that I lacked the experience to take on a challenge – and we've proved them wrong time and time again.**
We _can_ win this race. I feel it in my bones. **Unfortunately, the campaign arm of the Senate GOP is sitting on a war chest of $39 MILLION to defeat challengers like me, and right now, I'm still falling short of February's end-of-month fundraising goal with just hours to spare.**
**[So if you're with me to defeat Sen. Grassley, protect our Senate majority and fight for working families, then please donate $5, or whatever you can spare, before midnight tonight. This is a grassroots campaign, so I'm really counting on your donation before tonight's big fundraising deadline.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42336977/332589601/805649176?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk710-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDEvMS82MzU5NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NWU4ZGUzYi05Yjk4LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=T9QUQh85SIKP9Jx6c1Z7L0hixbx-Ia_wx_pFhiVHki0=)**

clean_body: My parents couldn't give me a trust fund or debt-free college, but what they taught me was so much more valuable ... | | | It's funny to think about how different my life was when this photo was taken – and how much is still the same as we build up this campaign to defeat Sen. Chuck Grassley (R-IA). Back then, all I knew was my small town of Sherrill in rural Iowa – around 200 people, five churches, a bar, a post office and a school. = I was raised in a working class family – my dad was a union pipe-fitter welder and my mom worked in the public school system. My parents couldn't give me a trust fund or debt-free college, but what they taught me was so much more valuable: how to treat people with respect; to never think you’re better than anyone else; and that when there is work to be done or a problem to solve, you say “yes.” = That's why, when my community needed a fighter in the Iowa State House, I stepped up and won my first election at only 25. I served for four years in the State House, and I fought hard to deliver for my constituents – one night, I kept the House in session until midnight to demand equal pay for women. = I was proud to serve in the State House, but the work didn't stop there for me. That's why I decided to run for Congress and became the youngest woman to flip a House seat from red to blue. Then, after just two weeks in Congress and during a government shutdown, I became the youngest woman to pass a bill through the House of Representatives with my legislation to create more opportunities for rural America. = My story is about service, community and understanding the value of hard work. That's why I'm running to defeat Sen. Chuck Grassley (R-IA) – to give working families a real fighter in the Senate. Right now, he's facing RECORD-LOW approval with Iowa voters, so we've got the best chance in decades to flip this seat blue and expand Democrats' Senate majority. = I know that defeating Sen. Grassley won't be a walk in the park. However, I've had plenty of people tell me that I was too young or that I lacked the experience to take on a challenge – and we've proved them wrong time and time again. We can win this race. I feel it in my bones. Unfortunately, the campaign arm of the Senate GOP is sitting on a war chest of $39 MILLION to defeat challengers like me, and right now, I'm still falling short of February's end-of-month fundraising goal with just hours to spare. = | | = Thank you, Abby | This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. name: V. Demings
subject: let me explain
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada
body:
| | |
---
I won't lie to you, friend. We're fighting an uphill battle right now. Let me explain:
**_FIRST,_****__** Republicans realized that if I win this race, Democrats are virtually guaranteed to expand our Senate majority.
**_THEN,_****__** polling showed me neck and neck with Marco Rubio, so national Republicans poured millions into Florida to stack the cards against me.
**_NOW,_****__** Mitch McConnell's committee is launching the first of many attack ads to defeat me – and I'm falling dangerously short of my $50,000 grassroots fundraising goal. I need to make up the difference before midnight, friend.
Republicans are trying to buy this seat – no matter how much money it takes – and I desperately need more resources right now to compete with Rubio.

Folks, Maryland families deserve true public servants who’ll deliver real results instead of empty rhetoric. Jazz has already proven he can do just that through his service in Maryland’s House of Delegates -- like banning solitary confinement for juveniles and pregnant women, funding a grocery store in a food desert, and getting the first cardiac care unit in Prince George’s County built.

subject: Public Dollars are for Public Schools
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bookbanning [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bookbanning]

Peter,

As Democrats, we believe that public dollars belong in public schools. Our public education system is the backbone of our nation. Efforts to privatize and reduce funding for our schools has left them in desperate need of attention, which only further emphasizes the need to fund and support them appropriately.

Bill Lee is determined to make the problem even worse by setting our schools up to fail to pave the way for his private school voucher program. He wants to build a theocracy based on far-right ideology, removing the barrier between church and state completely.

The stakes couldn’t be higher. Can you chip in $25 now to help us fight back against his private school heist? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bookbanning]

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bookbanning?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=express_lane_25]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bookbanning?express_lane=true&amount=50&refcode=express_lane_50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bookbanning?express_lane=true&amount=100&refcode=express_lane_100]
DONATE $250 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bookbanning?express_lane=true&amount=250&refcode=express_lane_250]
OTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bookbanning?express_lane_other=true&refcode=express_lane_other]

The equity and liberty that we have achieved as a nation is because of an educated population that understands the full context of our history and scientific achievements. We have a long way to go, but we can only fully realize the nation we know we can be if we fully fund our public schools so that no matter what zip code you’re born in, you receive a high quality education.

We have got to defeat Bill Lee this year and replace him with a Democrat who will fully fund our public schools and support our kids. Can you chip in $25 now to help us put Bill Lee out of a job? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bookbanning]

Thank you as always,

Brit Bender

name: Jake Evans for Congress
subject: Former Trump Ambassador to Israel Endorses Jake
body:
---
| | | | | |
---
| | For immediate release February 28th, 2022 Contact: (470) 588-2028, news@jakeevans.org
Trump's Ambassador to Israel backs Jake for Congress Former Trump administration U.S. Ambassador to Israel David Friedman today endorsed Jake Evans' campaign in Georgia's 6th Congressional District. "As a member of the House, Jake will continue the long tradition of Georgia Republicans standing strongly with Israel - our friend, partner and ally," Friedman said. "Jake understands the unique challenges of this small democracy as we face common enemies. He supports giving military aid, keeping our embassy in Jerusalem and encouraging business investment in Israel to counteract boycotts by others, and that's the kind of leadership we need at a time when America is no longer projecting strength to the world. I encourage the voters in Georgia's 6th District to rally to Jake's campaign." As an adviser to the 2016 Trump campaign and later as ambassador to Israel, Friedman played a critical role in moving the U.S. Embassy to Jerusalem from Tel Aviv - an action promised by many campaigns that was never delivered until the Trump administration. Prior to President Trump's election, Friedman served Trump as a personal lawyer for many years. "The way that Ambassador Friedman stood up to accomplish America First promises such as moving our embassy to Jerusalem and protecting our democratic ally in the Middle East embodies the bold conservatism that I'll bring to the House," Jake said. "I'm honored to have his support and look forward to furthering our shared goals when it comes to protecting Israel and returning our country to America First principles."

| Friend,

We recently learned that Michigan Congressman (and my friend) Dan Kildee is now part of the House Democrats’ “Frontline” program.

The "Frontline" races are 2022's most competitive, must-win races in the country. That means Dan has to win if Democrats are to keep their slim majority in the U.S. House of Representatives.

[Please split a donation between Dan Kildee's campaign and mine today and help protect our Democratic majority.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42351597/332651887/-1680338188?amount=10&refcode=DK_EM_FR_3MO_20220228_1_5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Nzg3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNWU0MTVhYS1iMzk4LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XjFItQ8-mS8Q5eN78cvgVzwXAyrzCIlxV8cNaMMEzc8=)

Here's why Dan's race is suddenly so competitive:
* Because of redistricting, Dan is now running in a competitive “toss-up” and Republican-leaning district.
* National Republicans have added his race to their top target list and are already running ads against Dan.
* President Biden won Dan’s current district (before redistricting) by just 8,000 votes in 2020.
* Dan already has one announced Republican opponent, with more on the way.

So this is going to be a tough race. But Dan is as tough as it gets, and with our help, I know he will win.

[So please, split a donation right now and send a message to Dan’s opponents that we're ready to fight for our Democratic majority in 2022.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42351599/332651889/-1680338188?amount=10&refcode=DK_EM_FR_3MO_20220228_1_5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Nzg3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNWU0MTVhYS1iMzk4LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XjFItQ8-mS8Q5eN78cvgVzwXAyrzCIlxV8cNaMMEzc8=)

Thank you so much,

Debbie

* * *
Congressman Dan Kildee – a Flint native – is proud to represent mid-Michigan. State of education

I don't believe the majority of the public really knows
what is being taught to our children and grandchildren. They
assume they are taught the same
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osyaPPnHuN

From the
Desk of Dr. Ben Carson:
Hello,
I don't
believe the majority of the public really knows what is being
taught to our children and grandchildren.
They
assume they are taught the same lessons we learned growing
up-that America is a land of freedom and opportunity where anyone
has a chance at success.
From what
I've seen, this isn't always the case. However, I want to know
what you've seen.

Dr. Ben
Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute
I believe
that children as young as elementary age are being taught to
reject our American values.
They are
told that our Founding Fathers were massively flawed and that it
overshadows the nation they built. They hear that our
Constitution is "out of date" and needs to be "modernized."

Progressives are rewriting our nation's history and they are
doing it with our youngest and most vulnerable. We cannot let
this happen!
At the
start of 2022, I'm going to be meeting with political leaders and
educational "experts" across the country. I'm going to make sure
people know what is really happening in our schools.
I want to
be able to share with them the thoughts of people who are closest
to the issue. Specifically, I would like to include your
thoughts.
The
American Cornerstone Institute, a nonprofit I recently founded,
has created a unique survey. We're trying to gauge the state of
America's Educational System by surveying people like you.
I'd like
to ask you to give me 2 minutes of your time so we can better
understand the problems that exist in our educational system. You
can access the survey here...

Dr. Ben

preserving individual and religious liberty, helping our

name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: Soon the Senate will vote on my legislation to enshrine the right to choose into law.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=uwDB7m3aIk40WAXSOrFplXvlN0hZ8QzB&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend,
In the face of both Republican-led states and a U.S. Supreme Court hostile to abortion rights, this grassroots team has spoken up like none other in support of my bill, the Women's Health Protection Act. It is time to guarantee a woman's right to make her own reproductive healthcare decisions.
**As a nation we 've reached a critical point in our fight to protect reproductive health as a fundamental freedom. Soon the Supreme Court will rule. But even sooner, the Senate will vote on this legislation. This is our moment to codify _Roe v. Wade_ into law. To protect the vast majority of Americans who agree they should make their own decisions about when and how to have a family. That this is a private and personal decision in which no right-wing legislators or federal courts has a right to have a say.**
This legislation has already passed through the House, and if we succeed in passing it through the Senate, President Biden will sign it into law. The stakes for such bold action are clear as day: In recent decisions involving challenges to Mississippi's and Texas' extremist abortion bans, the U.S. Supreme Court's majority of conservative justices has indicated its ready to greenlight the trampling of _Roe v. Wade_. Without action from Congress, a woman's right to make her own healthcare decisions could disappear in more and more states across the country.
Thankfully, there are 48 Democratic co-sponsors of this legislation - but we aren't in the clear yet. I am asking every last member of this team - including you, Friend - to make it unequivocally clear to the U.S. Senate that the American people want this legislation passed. That the American people want the extremist attacks on _Roe v. Wade_ 's well-established legal precedent to stop. That the American people want a country where women's healthcare is not regulated by the twisted ideology of a political party.
[**So please, before this vote on the Senate floor, sign on to one of the most important petitions I 've ever sent you: Tell the U.S. Senate to pass the Women's Health Protection Act into law and safeguard the American right to healthcare services in all situations.**](https://petitions.signforgood.com/blumenthal-WHPA-2022-vote?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500&code=jtk1150-su-nd&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsurveys.signforgood.com%2Fblumenthal-WHPA-SCOTUS%3Fcode%3Djtk1150-su-nd)
Thank you for all you've done to get us to this point. We are _so close_ to protecting women's healthcare, regardless of how this conservative U.S. Supreme Court rules. Let's make sure every last Senator knows where this team and the majority of Americans stand.
With so much gratitude,
Dick

The stakes for such bold action are clear as day: In recent decisions involving challenges to Mississippi's and Texas' extremist abortion bans, the U.S. Supreme Court's majority of conservative justices has indicated its ready to greenlight the trampling of Roe v. Wade. Without action from Congress, a woman's right to make her own healthcare decisions could disappear in more and more states across the country. Thankfully, there are 48 Democratic co-sponsors of this legislation - but we aren't in the clear yet. I am asking every last member of this team - including you, Friend - to make it unequivocally clear to the U.S. Senate that the American people want this legislation passed. That the American people want the extremist attacks on Roe v. Wade 's well-established legal precedent to stop. That the American people want a country where women's healthcare is not regulated by the twisted ideology of a political party. Thank you for all you've done to get us to this point. We are so close to protecting women's healthcare, regardless of how this conservative U.S. Supreme Court rules. Let's make sure every last Senator knows where this team and the majority of Americans stand. With so much gratitude, Dick

body:
One of the biggest hurdles candidates like me face is fundraising.
#

Friend,
All the pundits agree — Pennsylvania is this year's most important Senate race.
That's because, with Republican Pat Toomey retiring, ours is the seat most likely to flip. And it's a must-win to keep our Democratic majority in the Senate.
If we are going to finally have a government that works for working people, we need to fundamentally change who is in the United States Senate. That’s why I’m running.
For people like me who’ve faced eviction, had the heat turned off in the dead of winter, and racked up student debt for a shot at the American dream. For everyone who’s been left out.
But one of the biggest hurdles candidates like me face is fundraising. Unlike some of my opponents, I cannot afford to self-fund. And I flat-out refuse to take donations from corporate PACs or their lobbyists.
That means our campaign is powered by grassroots donations — everyday people who believe in our movement, chipping in a few bucks at a time.
And we have a big goal to hit by midnight to keep building on our people-powered movement. So I have a very important question for you.

name: Eli Bremer
subject: Can I count on you to vote for me in April?
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Eli For Colorado
body:
You don’t have to wait for November to vote for me ... here’s how!
|
---
Hello – Thank you for signing up on my website and your interest in my Senate campaign. I’m emailing to ask whether I can count on your vote this April. To vote for me in April you must be a Delegate to the Colorado State Republican Convention and Assembly (State Convention). **What do Delegates vote on at State Convention?** The Republican candidates who will be placed on the 2022 Republican Primary Ballot. Delegates are THE ONLY people in the entire state who can cast this vote, which is why I am writing to ask whether you will dedicate some of your very valuable time to becoming a Delegate. **How do you become a Delegate and vote for me? **
1. ATTEND YOUR PRECINCT CAUCUS AND RUN TO BE A DELEGATE.
2. ATTEND YOUR COUNTY ASSEMBLY AND CONFIRM YOUR DELEGATE SLOT TO STATE CONVENTION.
3. VOTE FOR ME AT THE STATE CONVENTION.

**When and where does all of this happen?**
1. Precinct caucuses will be held this week – Tuesday, March 1st through Saturday, March 5th.
* Precinct caucus dates and times are posted on each county’s Republican Party website. [Find your county on the map](https://d2p4X504.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Btc/OR+113/d2p4X504/VXjpKT6cD7jNVHF-mK1G94Q8W5XFwz14G4B9MN6mkvpB3q8_QV1-WJV7CgK7kW14b0gJ1dd359W63jcxm3D1sRyVYrX2Q4v9ZtHW9ldbTW4prlM9W6BXp-4559LYxW5ws_Pt1G3H3QW5cYvvs26Hg2JW89hn0f5xS6nNVLg-jZ2lhDNrW2FCbPK315zrrW95XfLb86mfmFW2P0JCf4t6gL9W29KPr18dR9R8W8_Z59Z8X6jvKW1J888t10nBYjW21QHv-19LMX7W6JG3qv71G-WFF8flPMJWg7rN1Hv9p0TG77LVyT5P412vMl7W4zwCvY5cPgD6W38WnK34z_1n03kMd1) to be directed to your county’s website.
* Precinct locations may be [found here](https://d2p4X504.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Btc/OR+113/d2p4X504/VXjpKT6cD7jNVHF-mK1G94Q8W5XFwz14G4B9MN6mkvpB3q8_QV1-WJV7CgTcdW6rMCj96QchrdW5W8Mnm8RmKFcVPt7vm3m05SmW3f-DB39d2mJyW1_n-C-3kcYdpW7Twfh33cW9K2V59VK91PvlMPN4SC1mwz7njQW695Zww1vGKvbW7Yx9kT6VZ_qgW1xqbM22G13_cV7YMj79fYPDRW1kSH_v1bHzXLW60_FP02BqdjnV_M4MN9jZk9MW193y5k2LbcQFW3PfDXS29ZcfwW2bxs_v2lTGxVW3-QWQ14R_ypZN5XwlCgHYdVTW4nP7sV2vylMsVHSQCx1WJ78z380T1) where you can also confirm your eligibility and pre-register, which may save you some time.
2. County Assemblies will be held after your Precinct Caucus and on or by Saturday, March 26th.
3. State Convention is on Saturday, April 9th starting at 9 AM in Colorado Springs.

**Are you sure I can get elected?** Since 2020, CO Republicans allocated an additional 1,400 Delegate slots for this year. **There is no need to worry about your odds of winning! ** _If you have never been a Delegate or gone through your caucus process, we know that it can be confusing. Don’t let the process intimidate you. The process is simple once you attend your precinct caucus_. **Additional resources ... for all of the convention details you can**[**visit our website**](https://d2p4X504.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Btc/OR+113/d2p4X504/VXjpKT6cD7jNVHF-mK1G94Q8W5XFwz14G4B9MN6mkvpB3q8_QV1-WJV7CgCnWW26817_7NsjK7N4fMNxtN1KgrVfPtLn2JQVMGW2yvhsP59xSJzN36rjdsg0hhDW98C8852lbzD0W3_6Y435ggTl5W6ytkMM4l3PmXW1K55Lb59BP45W4H0ppD6Dt8QvW1WDd672-0JbbW1_7TC31w_cFRW5wdz0529RThfW25L4Q83738xvW6CWGcB4X2-JcW8NnkDl5S7vdXW6tmR0m1RwxV9W6kdMwm13X35vW5hKT1J8FW2YGW4Mc2Rr4Q1_ZTW4H2JKy4k2QFsW5q-0JL60NgWZ2wW1)**, and email**[**info@eliforsenate.com**](mailto:info@eliforsenate.com)**with ANY questions.** Thank you for considering this request. Your participation in this process and vote at State Convention will go a long way to ensuring that I am on the ballot and ultimately CO’s Republican Nominee for the U.S. Senate.
---
Thank you,
---
---
Eli Bremer **P.S. You don’t have to wait for November to vote for me. If you are a Delegate to the State Convention you can vote for me in April and your vote will mean a lot to me and to making sure that I am the ONLY CANDIDATE to make it out of the State Convention and onto the Republican Ballot. **

Friends —
I have about 15 minutes of free time in my schedule today. I know that doesn’t sound like a lot of time, but with a schedule like mine I can assure you it’s a gift.
I want to take a few of those minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place, and ask you to split a donation between my re-election campaign and Maggie Hassan's campaign. Your support is so important to our success.
The truth is, when Gabby and I first started talking about running, we weren’t sure what to expect. We knew that Arizona needed new leadership in the Senate — someone who would always put the people of our state first, who was willing to work across the aisle to deliver real results, and who would prioritize building bridges between parties — not burning them down.
We also knew we had some friends who would help us out. But when you’re talking about such a big campaign, we’d need support from a lot of people we hadn’t met yet as well.
You know the rest... we won in 2020 in large part because we ran the biggest grassroots campaign Arizona has ever seen.
But now we have a new mission: Re-election.

Friend,

I’ll get straight to the point.

Senator Rick Scott (R-FL), the chair of the National Republican Senatorial Committee, released a 31-page, 11-point plan to "rescue America" – forgetting exactly who it is that we need to save our country from.

As a **U.S. Marine veteran** , and now serving as your **representative in Congress** , I _know_ what problems Americans are dealing with – and this GOP plan addresses absolutely none of them.

Rick Scott and the Trump Machine are banking on flipping the Senate and the House this November. But I know we have the power and the movement to keep and expand our hard won majority. **This is why it is so important we flip this seat, right here in Pennsylvania.**

**[Will you join me today and rush a donation to my campaign to make sure we not only turn our Commonwealth blue, but ensure this heinous 11-point GOP pipe dream does not become reality?>>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42355026/332665810/1085202693?refcode=em22_220228_scott&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82MzE3OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwN2M2YzY4Zi1iYzk4LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wnGK5oT43w9ysWrRd_nmlgY-1AXrCdkHrEkNJezNE4g=)** [RUSH A DONATION](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42355029/332665812/1085202693?refcode=em22_220228_scott&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82MzE3OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwN2M2YzY4Zi1iYzk4LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wnGK5oT43w9ysWrRd_nmlgY-1AXrCdkHrEkNJezNE4g=) The "priorities" the GOP lays out don't include fighting for our working families, don't include preserving our democracy, and don't include advocating for true equality.

body:
Ohio deserves better than the corruption currently plaguing the statehouse.

Team,
For far too long, working families across Ohio have had to watch scandal after scandal dominate our headlines and destroy our opportunities.
The same corrupt crew has been getting richer for 30 years – and we’re the ones paying the price. The pay-to-play politics that have hurt our communities needs to end.
**[Ohioans deserve a government they can trust. We can fight corruption and build a stronger Ohio, but I need your support. Will you pitch in $20 towards our February goal?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42355877/332668761/-528457057?refcode=nw_em_220228_1_t2_c&amount=20&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxN2EzOTQ3Ny1iZjk4LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TVXd44QdTjUnjDTTJhPeIxSZ7r5mebGYW6h5sQ-DAIY=)**
The moment I stepped foot in Dayton, I knew Ohio was my home. I fell in love, and not just with my husband! Serving as the mayor of Dayton and being able to give back to the community that welcomed me so eagerly all those years ago was the honor of a lifetime.
But I didn’t become mayor without a lot of work. I grew up in a working class family and watched my parents – like so many others – do everything they could to improve our lives. They taught me the meaning of hard work, and I couldn’t have run for mayor without the lessons I learned from them.
I’m the only non-millionaire in this race. That puts me in the same boat as the vast majority of Ohioans who are also not millionaires. Not having that kind of money hasn’t stopped me from working hard and giving back to my community, and it certainly isn’t going to stop me now – especially because I have something far better: you on my team.
**[Can you donate $20 to my campaign? Ohio deserves better than the corruption currently plaguing the statehouse, but we can only make it happen together. Nan Whaley

Team, For far too long, working families across Ohio have had to watch scandal after scandal dominate our headlines and destroy our opportunities. The same corrupt crew has been getting richer for 30 years – and we’re the ones paying the price. The pay-to-play politics that have hurt our communities needs to end. = The moment I stepped foot in Dayton, I knew Ohio was my home. I fell in love, and not just with my husband! Serving as the mayor of Dayton and being able to give back to the community that welcomed me so eagerly all those years ago was the honor of a lifetime. But I didn’t become mayor without a lot of work. I grew up in a working class family and watched my parents – like so many others – do everything they could to improve our lives. They taught me the meaning of hard work, and I couldn’t have run for mayor without the lessons I learned from them. I’m the only non-millionaire in this race. That puts me in the same boat as the vast majority of Ohioans who are also not millionaires. | | Dear Peter, I’m inspired by how many people have joined our campaign in February, and yet our end of the month deadline is crucial. **I need your support before midnight. ** I’ve started rolling out my policy platforms, and I’ll continue to lay out my vision for our state. Oregonians who are fed up with the status quo are counting on us to succeed. **We’re going to leave it all on the field, Peter, and your support is critical to our strategy for success.** **[So I’m asking: Will you please contribute TODAY to help bring real change to Oregon?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42356087/332670356/-2045037038?refcode=em022822&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MGU4NDkzZS1jMDk4LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3vLIDQF_OTSAggIKKl_S9ldZHUNz6WGe-R7IXK_jnjI=)** I think we all agree that Oregon is in desperate need of change. Change in the way we approach problems, think about solutions, and most importantly **a change from talking about problems to _doing something about them._** All of that requires new leadership. **More of the same just isn’t something we can afford right now.** Our state’s largest employer is choosing to develop elsewhere, graduation rates are lagging, and the homelessness crisis is getting worse. **Everywhere I go, the message I’m hearing from voters is that business as usual can’t go on any more.** Our businesses, our students, and our working families need, expect and deserve better. **[Your contribution today will mean that we can get the message out that we don’t have to be satisfied with the status quo.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42356089/332670361/-2045037038?refcode=em022822&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MGU4NDkzZS1jMDk4LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3vLIDQF_OTSAggIKKl_S9ldZHUNz6WGe-R7IXK_jnjI=)** Stay safe,

Peter,
Last week, President Biden nominated Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson to the Supreme Court.
Judge Jackson’s nomination was only possible because of the work we did to take back the White House in 2020. And we’ll work to give her a fair confirmation process thanks to our slim Senate majority – something this team dug deep and fought for when we helped elect new Senators in Georgia.
**[The future of the Supreme Court is on the line. To win these fights, we must grow and expand our Senate majority – not let the GOP gain ground. | | Dear Friend, Do any of these names sound familiar to you: Brutus, Publius, Cato, Cicero, or Cincinnatus? While many Americans today wouldn’t recognize these names, our Founding Fathers admired and studied these heroes of the Roman Republic. If you’ve ever read _The Federalist Papers_ or visited Cincinnati, Ohio, they may ring a bell.
---
| | [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zlio40mqhfvbp5273igfj64fkd9rk72gdadrttv8_rp22sh2s8i66ob3c1jm8oj4clh2bs)
---
| | That’s because many of our Founders looked at the heroes of the Roman Republic as models of civic virtue to emulate. Likewise, they viewed the descent of Rome into tyranny and discord as a cautionary tale their new republican form of government was designed to address. These are a few of the reasons we’re releasing our newest free online course, **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic,”** next month. Our Founders knew that the Roman Republic provided an essential study for every person interested in free government, military strategy, political theory, and the perennial questions of human nature. ** **Now you can learn these same lessons with Hillsdale College...for free!** Remember, courses like **“The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic”** are free and supported entirely by the generosity of friends like you. We rely on the generous funding provided by so many. I want you to know that a donation is NOT required to experience the full course—it’s truly free and open to all who wish to learn as part of the College’s mission. **So please, pre-register today, even if you can’t make a gift to support the course or our other educational outreach.** [_**You can watch the trailer and pre-register now for “The Rise and Fall of the Roman Republic” at this secure page »**_](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zl7d8kve25pqr65jjrr9na2le25skp73gvmgemi8_rp22sh2s8i66ob3c1jm8oj4clh2bs) __ Best regards, Kyle Murnen, ’09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

body:
Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson is making Black history.
Team —

Last Friday, President Joe Biden nominated Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson for the Supreme Court of the United States, the first African American woman to ever be nominated for the bench.

I know Judge Jackson will fight for justice and fairness in the highest court in the land. Her lived experiences and her unwavering dedication to the rule of law make her a worthy addition to the bench.

As we come to the close of Black History Month, this historic nomination is a reminder that Black history is made every single day. As our campaign moves forward, we must strive to honor the activists who came before us. We are standing on the shoulders of giants like the late Congressman John Lewis, Dr. Martin Luther King, and Maya Angelou while we continue to make strides.

Every day is a struggle to push the needle further toward equity, justice, and fair representation, but we're doing it together. Team, I look forward to what we will accomplish, and I know that if we fight, we will make history again.

Thank you,

Karen

| Erik is ready to lead - debate No. 3 shows it
---
| |
---|---
|
Driven by his desire to serve his country especially at a time of crisis in our world, U.S. Congressional candidate Erik Aadland demonstrated once again last week that he is the right choice for the 7th Congressional District of Colorado.

Erik and four other candidates vying for the Republican nomination squared off in Broomfield Feb. 24 in a forum hosted by the North Metro Conservatives.

As the question of the United States role in the Russian invasion of Ukraine hangs in the balance, Erik showed his leadership and experience are what is needed in Washington. He showed great compassion toward the people of Ukraine and noted that for the U.S. to show any strength, we must be energy independent.

"We have to restore our energy independence; we have to restore the construction of the Keystone pipeline and turn that on. We must make America energy independent and not reliant on our enemies, like Russian and China, or upon the middle eastern OPEC nations--we need to reenergize our economy," Erik said.
| |
---|---
|
Erik also offered solutions to the issues that cause us to lose sleep at night: crushing inflation, skyrocketing crime, and how to return the U.S. to a position of strength both at home and on the world stage.

"You don't need to be an economist to recognize that reckless and abusive spending and the unlimited printing of money is going to drive inflation up," Erik said. "Inflation is a hidden tax on the American people and is a direct result of federal reserve policy. We have a federal reserve that is not accountable to our government and that is a major problem."

Finally, Erik offered his thoughts about why he is running for Congress--to help the people of Colorado and our nation attain a better life, one that is secure, prosperous, and productive. He called for a balanced budget amendment, a renewed effort to make America energy independent, ridding our country of deadly fentanyl distribution, and securing our borders.

"Fentanyl is the leading cause of death from those age 18-45--that's a direct result of a porous southern border. Securing our borders is a federal charge," Erik said. "We need to secure our borders, we need to build a wall because walls work, and we need solid immigration policies that prevent human trafficking, prevent the movement of drugs and the exploitation of the border by cartels."
| |
---|---
|
Once again, Erik showed that in a time of crisis, when we have multiple challenges on the horizon, he is best to lead our nation to course correction and represent the interests of the people of Colorado.

"We come together during this time of unprecedented crisis, this generational crisis. It's not just one crisis, it's not just Ukraine. We have a porous southern border, we have inflation out of control, we have crime out of control in our cities, we have an unprecedented level of distrust in our institutions, we have Americans fighting Americans right now and what we need is strong leadership to solve these crises. As a combat veteran and someone who was a tech in the oil and gas industry who has helped make this country energy independent and the country of Israel energy independent, I am unique suited to address these crises and I look forward to serving as your next representative. I will serve you, the people, not special interests in Washington."

clean_body: Debate No. 3 shows distinction from other candidates | | | | == | | Erik is ready to lead - debate No. 3 shows it | | ---|--- | Driven by his desire to serve his country especially at a time of crisis in our world, U.S. Congressional candidate Erik Aadland demonstrated once again last week that he is the right choice for the 7th Congressional District of Colorado. Erik and four other candidates vying for the Republican nomination squared off in Broomfield Feb. 24 in a forum hosted by the North Metro Conservatives. As the question of the United States role in the Russian invasion of Ukraine hangs in the balance, Erik showed his leadership and experience are what is needed in Washington. He showed great compassion toward the people of Ukraine and noted that for the U.S. to show any strength, we must be energy independent. "We have to restore our energy independence; we have to restore the construction of the Keystone pipeline and turn that on. We must make America energy independent and not reliant on our enemies, like Russian and China, or upon the middle eastern OPEC nations--we need to reenergize our economy," Erik said. | | ---|--- | Erik also offered solutions to the issues that cause us to lose sleep at night: crushing inflation, skyrocketing crime, and how to return the U.S. to a position of strength both at home and on the world stage. "You don't need to be an economist to recognize that reckless and abusive spending and the unlimited printing of money is going to drive inflation up," Erik said. "Inflation is a hidden tax on the American people and is a direct result of federal reserve policy. We have a federal reserve that is not accountable to our government and that is a major problem." Finally, Erik offered his thoughts about why he is running for Congress--to help the people of Colorado and our nation attain a better life, one that is secure, prosperous, and productive. He called for a balanced budget amendment, a renewed effort to make America energy independent, ridding our country of deadly fentanyl distribution, and securing our borders. "Fentanyl is the leading cause of death from those age 18-45--that's a direct result of a porous southern border. Securing our borders is a federal charge," Erik said. "We need to secure our borders, we need to build a wall because walls work, and we need solid immigration policies that prevent human trafficking, prevent the movement of drugs and the exploitation of the border by cartels." | | ---|--- | Once again, Erik showed that in a time of crisis, when we have multiple challenges on the horizon, he is best to lead our nation to course correction and represent the interests of the people of Colorado. "We come together during this time of unprecedented crisis, this generational crisis. It's not just one crisis, it's not just Ukraine. We have a porous southern border, we have inflation out of control, we have crime out of control in our cities, we have an unprecedented level of distrust in our institutions, we have Americans fighting Americans right now and what we need is strong leadership to solve these crises. As a combat veteran and someone who was a tech in the oil and gas industry who has helped make this country energy independent and the country of Israel energy independent, I am unique suited to address these crises and I look forward to serving as your next representative. Dear Peter,

It’s not everyday when your Office has an opportunity to lead an argument at the U.S. Supreme Court on one of the most important questions facing our republic.

Who gets to **DECIDE** the major questions of the day? Congress, and the people’s representatives, or an unelected bureaucracy?

In today’s case, the unelected bureaucracy is the EPA and how much authority that agency possesses to regulate carbon emissions. But tomorrow, there may be another rogue federal agency at work expanding federal overreach in some way.

We need clarity from the court on this critical separation of powers case.

This morning, I go into the Supreme Court, where my team will lead arguments in the West Virginia v. EPA case. name: Eugene DePasquale
subject: An important message
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY DEPASQUALE FOR PA-10 Follow Eugene on social media for campaign updates:
body:
I am incredibly grateful for the support of my family, friends, and the activists who are the backbone of our campaign | | | Friends and Neighbors,

Over the past 11 months, I have actively explored another run for Congress in my home district of PA-10. However, after careful consideration, I’ve decided I will not be a candidate in 2022.

When I first entered public service, I did so because it felt like the best way to help families who faced the same challenges mine did growing up. The reason I care so much about issues like raising the minimum wage so people can live with dignity, or making sure anyone can see a doctor when they need one, is because I’ve lived those same struggles myself. That desire to bring meaningful change to people’s lives will not be deterred by today’s decision.

At the close of my last campaign, I spoke of the challenges we faced as Americans and the need for unity to meet them. Now, at a time of persistent inflation, global instability, and an ongoing assault on our institutions and rights, Scott Perry has done the opposite, perpetuating far-right conspiracies and trafficking in hostility and contempt. That is not leadership. The people of PA-10 deserve so much better.

While I had hoped for a fairer, more competitive district in which to run, the recent redistricting process has resulted in a district that, in my opinion, will continue to reward candidates who peddle in extremism and division. That is not who I am, and therefore, I do not see a path forward.

I am incredibly grateful for the support of my family, friends, donors and the activists who are the backbone of our campaign, and I am especially thankful to the voters who put their faith in me in each of my previous campaigns for office. It has been the honor of my life to serve the good people of this Commonwealth. The passion I have for solving our shared challenges has not and will not ever change, and neither will my desire to play a part in fixing them. It is my promise that I will find other ways to stay in the fight, because what lies ahead of us is just too important not to.
Thank you,

Eugene

subject: LGBTQ People Under Attack in Texas, Florida, and Pennsylvania

body:
Deja Alvarez is running to become the first openly trans Latina member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives. | | | | [ ](https://dejaforpa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b6353e8c7ba78b936853cab9&id=f5a00293d7&e=3f8e2ea1e3)
---
|
In Texas, they are making our existence illegal.

In Florida, they are erasing us from society altogether.

Here, in Pennsylvania, they are taking the “frog in the pot” approach of slowly stripping away trans childrens’ rights to life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness.

The new “Don’t Say Gay” bill in Florida and horrific directive from the Texas Governor to deny life-saving gender-affirming treatments are the latest in a long line of attacks on the existence, freedom, and dignity of LGBTQ+ individuals. **And this is all happened in just a matter of weeks.**

Over the years, we have seen our government systematically stripping away our rights and vilifying the most vulnerable and marginalized, particularly the transgender community. Here, our PA legislature is ripe with anti-trans legislation. One of the latest attempts has been the bill HB 972 the Fairness in Women’s Sports Act, which is discriminatory to the trans community and does nothing to address the real problems in women’s sports, access, and resources.

**A new report declares that****[2022 could be most anti-trans legislative year in history](https://dejaforpa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b6353e8c7ba78b936853cab9&id=648354d6ba&e=3f8e2ea1e3)****.** We are potentially facing a historic year of legislation to further erode the rights of transgender individuals, with roughly 280 proposals in statehouses across the country.

This is why representation is so incredibly crucial at this moment.

This is why we need a seat at the table, a voice in the room, and a leader who will fight to protect the rights and dignity of all LGBTQ Americans.

[Can you chip in today for historic representation in Harrisburg?](https://dejaforpa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b6353e8c7ba78b936853cab9&id=5278b734de&e=3f8e2ea1e3)

Our district is a true swing district. Virginia's new Republican governor won our redrawn district lines by 5.5 points this past November. **But thanks to you, I 'm no stranger to winning in super competitive elections!**

Holding seats like Virginia's 7th District is the key to holding the House majority. name: Ted Deutch
subject: Sharing some news
body:
Dear Friend,

Throughout my seven terms in Congress, you have been a loyal friend and supporter which is why I wanted to you to hear from me that I will not be seeking re-election to Congress in 2022.

I will continue the work I’ve done in Congress combating rising antisemitism and advocating for a safe, secure and prosperous Israel, and defending democratic values as the next Chief Executive Officer of the American Jewish Committee.

Serving in Congress has been the greatest honor of my lifetime. Your support has helped sustain me throughout my political career, and I will be forever grateful to you. I look forward to continuing our friendship for years to come.

Warm regards,
Ted

Dear Friend,

It’s my mission to run my campaign on a bedrock of key principles, including wisdom, justice, courage, kindness, democratic freedom, and equality under the law. If I had to sum up in one word why I'm running, it would be Service. I have a strong sense of duty and hope to offer Northern Michigan true, honest and ethical representation. Together, with your support, we can fulfill the needs of our communities' everyday citizens and working families. I'm confident I can be an effective member of Congress for the 1st District and guide us on a national and worldwide stage under the ideals and principles of what it means to be a proud American. I truly care about every single one of you, whether you are a democrat, republican, or independent. If elected I will strive to be the voice for all residents of my district. My family, friends, and staff have put everything we have into turning our vision of this great state into a reality and we will continue to work towards achieving that objective. Every day we are building and strengthening partnerships with voters and citizens alike who are aligned with the vision we want to bring to the United States and Northern Michigan. I particularly love meeting and working with the younger generations, as they are truly the voice of the future and are very active and enthusiastic in learning how to be involved. The United States is divided economically, politically, and culturally more than ever before. It's time to unite. It's time to come together and push for government solutions that reflect the best of Northern Michigan's values and priorities. Who am I? Marquette, Michigan has been my home since 1989. I've been married for nearly 40 years to Peggy, and we raised three children and now enjoy grandchildren. After being educated with advanced degrees in public health, social work, and medicine, I attended medical school and started my career with the Indian Health Service, serving the Navajo Nation. I then spent two-plus decades as a family physician in Marquette, serving in a variety of roles. Then from a desire for national service, Peggy and I joined the Department of State as a Diplomat for ten years. We did five tours — Pakistan during the search and capture of Osama bin Laden, South Korea, Afghanistan, Morocco, and finally in Iraq for the last two years of that work. We arrived home in the Fall of 2020 to a planned retirement that never happened. Instead, I joined Marquette County Health Department as their medical director during the COVID pandemic again out of a sense of service and the community’s needs. I truly care about every single one of you, whether you are a democrat, republican, or independent. If elected I will strive to be the voice for all residents of my district. My family, friends, and staff have put everything we have into turning our vision of this great state into a reality and we will continue to work towards achieving that objective. Every day we are building and strengthening partnerships with voters and citizens alike who are aligned with the vision we want to bring to the United States and Northern Michigan. I particularly love meeting and working with the younger generations, as they are truly the voice of the future and are very active and enthusiastic in learning how to be involved. The United States is divided economically, politically, and culturally more than ever before. It's time to unite. It's time to come together and push for government solutions that reflect the best of Northern Michigan's values and priorities. Who am I? Marquette, Michigan has been my home since 1989. I've been married for nearly 40 years to Peggy, and we raised three children and now enjoy grandchildren. After being educated with advanced degrees in public health, social work, and medicine, I attended medical school and started my career with the Indian Health Service, serving the Navajo Nation. I then spent two-plus decades as a family physician in Marquette, serving in a variety of roles. Then from a desire for national service, Peggy and I joined the Department of State as a Diplomat for ten years. We did five tours — Pakistan during the search and capture of Osama bin Laden, South Korea, Afghanistan, Morocco, and finally in Iraq for the last two years of that work. We arrived home in the Fall of 2020 to a planned retirement that never happened. Instead, I joined Marquette County Health Department as their medical director during the COVID pandemic again out of a sense of service and the community’s needs. Growing up in a small Midwest rural community, it wasn't always easy — my parents divorced early, worked paycheck to paycheck, and sometimes my family relied on government aid. We suffered the consequences of alcoholism, but we worked hard and were surrounded by love. It was through sheer luck I found talented educators, great mentors, and a quality education at a community college. I went on to attain three advanced degrees without insurmountable debt. We lived in a safe, clean neighborhood. We had affordable housing, access to medical care, sound infrastructure, and good jobs. As much as we care about this country, we also care about your privacy. Our critical February End-of-Month deadline is just hours away. But right now, we are still $771 short of our goal. Thank you, Team Barletta \---------- Forwarded message --------- From: Barletta for Governor Subject: Final Request To: Peter Willis, Lou asked us to reach out to you because he needs your help. Gov. Wolf has done his best to keep the state of Pennsylvania depressed because depressed people are easily controlled. But it’s time to end the mandates, end the restrictions, and bring freedom back to the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania. And that’s exactly what Lou will do when he is elected Governor. But he can’t get there unless we raise the remaining $4,724 of our February goal before the end-of-month deadline February 28th at 11:59 P.M. Meeting this end-of-month fundraising goal is the difference between holding politicians accountable for what they put us through during COVID, and laying down and handing our freedom over to them. Lou Barletta has made his choice to fight. Now he hopes he can count on you to fight alongside him.
