---
| | On February 24, 2022, Russia launched a large-scale invasion of Ukraine. This unprovoked aggression came in the form of tanks, missiles, and armed soldiers encroaching on the sovereignty of Ukraine. As of February 26, an estimated 352 civilians have been killed and 1,684 have been wounded so far. The invasion has displaced hundreds of thousands of people in Ukraine, with the United Nations estimating over 422,000 refugees attempting to escape from Ukraine in the wake of Putin’s aggression. These refugees need a place to go. In response, bordering nations have begun accepting refugees from Ukraine; Poland, Slovakia, Hungary, Romania, and Moldova have mobilized to receive Ukrainian refugees and provide shelter, food, and legal assistance. These nations are doing everything they can to ensure Ukrainians can get out of the country as fast as they can. As a result of the massive influx of refugees fleeing Ukraine, lines at these border crossings have become massive with cars lined up for nine miles.
---
| | The nations surrounding Ukraine should not be the only ones shouldering the brunt of the wave of Ukrainian refugees – and other nations agree. Many nations, such as Ireland, have lifted visa requirements of Ukrainians allowing Ukrainian refugees to enter without hassle. Several European nations are preparing themselves for the influx of Ukrainian refugees and have already started to provide humanitarian aid. The United States should follow suit by – 1\. Providing additional humanitarian assistance on Ukrainian borders to help streamline the process of getting Ukrainians out of the country.2\. Raising the annual cap on the number of refugees admitted into the United States.3\. Offering refugee status to any Ukrainian wishing to resettle in the United States.4\. Granting requests of Humanitarian Parole to all Ukrainian nationals who flee to the United States. The United States must also issue Special Student Relief (SSR), Temporary Protected Status (TPS), and Deferred Enforced Departure (DED) to eligible Ukrainians in the United States to ensure they are not deported back to Ukraine in the middle of this war.
---
| | The UN has stated that the number of refugees fleeing from Ukraine to other nations could rise to almost five million. The United States must play its part as a global leader to help these refugees as much as it can! With these policy initiatives, the world can come together and provide meaningful aid to Ukrainians who lost their homes due to Putin's senseless violence.

| | I stand with the people of Ukraine. | | The Right Choice for Nebraska

| | The home stretch is in sight

|
---
| | My fellow Nebraskans,

It is a pleasure to be able to connect with you once again. As you probably know, Russia has officially invaded Ukraine. This Russia-Ukraine war is no trivial matter to ignore. It has been long coming and is, what I believe, the start to a larger situation.

Why should this matter to you?

I won't go into the details about the who, what, and why of the invasion. My intent is to simply explain why we should all be paying attention. This war could potentially result in a higher cost of goods, higher national debt, devalue of the U.S. Dollar, and loss of life. If and when China invades Taiwan, and they are ever-increasing their posture to do so, it will be an incredible financial pain to many Nebraskans. We as a people must prepare our households and businesses for supply chain interruptions, significant decrease in income, and acquisition limitations.

I am frustrated and disappointed that our leadership has not expressed any warning or early recommendations for preparations to Nebraskans thus far. I believe we need proactive leadership in Nebraska that has the foresight to see problems before they arrive and develop a plan to prepare Nebraskans. I want Nebraskans to thrive during tough times, not be dependent on the government because their leadership failed to prepare them. Or worse, they are significantly impacted and government CAN'T help them.

What can you do? 1\. Continue to pray for our state and national leadership. God is in control. 2\. Prioritize financial obligations.3. Ensure you have a healthy supply of foods, medications, and necessities to weather any supply interruptions.4\. Vote for me on May 10th.

As Governor, I will have a lot of influence on the federal level. Even now, I have a good relationship with many of our federal representatives and they know I am a trusted and respected voice. I have put a lot of time and effort in developing these relationships because I want to hit the ground running when elected governor. I want to be as effective and efficient as I can be as the next leader of our state.

Thank you for your continued support for my campaign and I greatly look forward to representing and leading our state as Nebraska's next governor.

God Bless,

Breland Ridenour

| | For this month's newsletter, we're taking a different approach. Normally we like to recap all the events Breland has been involved in, including appearances, meet and greets, debates, etc. Long time subscribers are plenty used to getting the ins and outs of events on the campaign trail. However, we're officially entering the home stretch. These next few months are going to FLY BY! May 10th primaries are just around the corner. So now is the time for you and many other Nebraskans' support to mobilize and get Breland's name and message out there. We CANNOT do it alone. What is the immediate goal? We implore you dear voter to donate to the campaign via the link at the bottom of this message. Our goal is to raise $5,000 over the next month or so. If everyone receiving this email pitched in at least $20, we'd be well on our way to crushing that goal! This $5,000 would help us with our strategy to exercise further reach than Breland has already established thus far. This strategy would include purchases of: \- Reserving spaces in key (5-8) regional areas of the state to hold intimate meet and greets\- Mailers to inform folks around those regions of said meet and greets\- Gear such as pamphlets, yard signs, etc. to give out at meet and greets\- Accommodate meet and greets with basic snacks, drinks, gear, etc.-Assembling a call team to cold call voters to close out primary season Why this strategy? We've decided this is the best path for Breland's grassroots candidacy, as money is limited by nature of his campaign. The big money guys can make $5,000 with just a few phone calls, and only appreciate that kind of money so much. But to a grassroots campaign such as Breland's it could mean the difference between having a puncher's chance or folding. You heard that right - your contribution today could very well be what swings this election in favor of the candidate you personally support - Breland Ridenour! We researched and analyzed lots of election data. The typical TV ads, radio ads, billboard rentals, door to door field teams, etc. appear to have little return considering the lofty investment each method demands. Our research shows us that ultimately, the voter prioritizes face to face interactions much more. Breland's specialty has been his priding himself on driving the four corners of our state to have those conversations with voters. However, these are usually in the context of candidate forums or county party meetings. While great and conducive to securing more votes, these events are often capped for time for a single candidate to really have the ideal, intimate interaction with the voters in attendance. By securing places to hold intimate meet and greets/Q&A's with Breland as the sole topic, we believe we could put these funds to tremendous use in a much more cost effective manner! After all, we don't wish to waste your hard earned dollars. Breland himself loathes government waste of our taxpayer dollars, so you can count on him emulating how he'll conduct himself while in office right now while he's still campaigning. Please consider Breland's personal message above, and consider the forces we're up against here and elsewhere in the world at this time. If you want a more transparent and vocal leader in the Governor's Mansion, then we need to rally around him and his fundraiser goals! Unfortunately money talks in politics. Even though he's not about it himself, it does ultimately cost money to get his name and message in front of others. That's half the battle...a sound message is the other half, and he's got that one nailed! Thank you for considering donating to the Ridenour campaign. We all want better leadership in our country, and it all starts at the local/state level. The 2022 election is where we can make our voices heard through our candidate! Looking to help in other ways? Please read below!

As you probably know, Russia has officially invaded Ukraine. This Russia-Ukraine war is no trivial matter to ignore. It has been long coming and is, what I believe, the start to a larger situation. Why should this matter to you? I won't go into the details about the who, what, and why of the invasion. My intent is to simply explain why we should all be paying attention. This war could potentially result in a higher cost of goods, higher national debt, devalue of the U.S. Dollar, and loss of life. If and when China invades Taiwan, and they are ever-increasing their posture to do so, it will be an incredible financial pain to many Nebraskans. We as a people must prepare our households and businesses for supply chain interruptions, significant decrease in income, and acquisition limitations. I am frustrated and disappointed that our leadership has not expressed any warning or early recommendations for preparations to Nebraskans thus far. I believe we need proactive leadership in Nebraska that has the foresight to see problems before they arrive and develop a plan to prepare Nebraskans. I want Nebraskans to thrive during tough times, not be dependent on the government because their leadership failed to prepare them. Or worse, they are significantly impacted and government CAN'T help them. What can you do? 1\. Continue to pray for our state and national leadership. God is in control. 2\. Prioritize financial obligations.3. Ensure you have a healthy supply of foods, medications, and necessities to weather any supply interruptions.4\. Vote for me on May 10th. As Governor, I will have a lot of influence on the federal level. Even now, I have a good relationship with many of our federal representatives and they know I am a trusted and respected voice. I have put a lot of time and effort in developing these relationships because I want to hit the ground running when elected governor. However, we're officially entering the home stretch. These next few months are going to FLY BY! May 10th primaries are just around the corner. So now is the time for you and many other Nebraskans' support to mobilize and get Breland's name and message out there. We CANNOT do it alone. What is the immediate goal? We implore you dear voter to donate to the campaign via the link at the bottom of this message. Our goal is to raise $5,000 over the next month or so. We've decided this is the best path for Breland's grassroots candidacy, as money is limited by nature of his campaign. The big money guys can make $5,000 with just a few phone calls, and only appreciate that kind of money so much. However, these are usually in the context of candidate forums or county party meetings. While great and conducive to securing more votes, these events are often capped for time for a single candidate to really have the ideal, intimate interaction with the voters in attendance. By securing places to hold intimate meet and greets/Q&A's with Breland as the sole topic, we believe we could put these funds to tremendous use in a much more cost effective manner! | | | Hi there,

**My name is Mike Van Someren and I’m running for the U.S. House of Representatives in Wisconsin’s 5th Congressional District in Milwaukee’s western suburbs.** I’m a father, business attorney, and former Badger football player. My wife Renee and I live in the Town of Delafield with our two young daughters and chocolate lab, Buckley.

I am a pragmatic, moderate Democrat I'm ready to replace longtime politician Rep. Scott Fitzgerald. This is my first run for elective office — I am not a lifelong or “career” politician.

---
|
---
|
---
| [MORE ABOUT MIKE](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=d99d403d22&e=356c0699dd "MORE ABOUT MIKE")
---
| I’m not from a political or wealthy family. And I’m not in lockstep with every Democrat. Here is what I am – I am a middle-class family man willing to try, to listen, to learn and to lead. I want to recognize the progress that has been made in this country, while acknowledging that more needs to be done to help the average person get ahead, and do what I can to help make that happen.

I am running for Congress to do the hard work of governing. I am running to listen to the voices of those who support me — as well as those who do not. I am running to advocate for the best interest of this district, the country, and the people who live here.

I cannot possibly do this without your support.

Thank you,

Mike Van Someren

_P.S. I look forward to chatting with you about the future of our district and the great state of Wisconsin. #### **NRCC Elevates Barrett to Young Guns Program**
Lansing, MI - The National Republican Congressional Committee announced that Republican congressional candidate, Tom Barrett, has been named an “On the Radar” candidate for the NRCC Young Guns program. Young Guns is a recruitment program led by House Republican Leader Kevin McCarthy focused on taking back the House of Representatives by identifying and supporting well-credentialed, conservative candidates across the country who have demonstrated their ability to run successful, well-funded campaigns.“I am honored to be named an ‘On the Radar’ candidate for the Young Guns program,” said Tom Barrett. “We know that all roads to a Republican majority run through Michigan’s 7th congressional district. I look forward to working with the NRCC to flip this seat in November.”In 2020, 25 Young Guns were elected to House of Representatives. Since its launch, the NRCC’s Young Guns program has helped elect over 150 Members of Congress.

subject: Essence Magazine

body:
There’s no Black women in the U.S. Senate. Together, we can make it happen.
# [](https://act.morganharper.org/go/1512?refcode=em20220228-727-footer-ak&t=2&akid=727%2E90090%2EIj6z6q)
Did you see this?
[](https://act.morganharper.org/go/28028?t=3&akid=727%2E90090%2EIj6z6q)
I had the absolute honor of being interviewed by _Essence_ about my journey to be the FIRST Black woman elected to the U.S. Senate from Ohio.
I can’t do it without you, so I have to ask: [**_Can I count on your contribution of $5 or more today? We still haven’t met our $11,211 online fundraising goal and we only have until midnight tonight to reach it._**](https://act.morganharper.org/go/28028?t=4&akid=727%2E90090%2EIj6z6q)
Let me keep it real with you, _I'm in an extremely uphill battle_. I’m a Black woman running for office. And there’s extensive research that **Black women candidates raise on average half of what white candidates raise.**
There’s no sugarcoating that! And on top of the racism and sexism that I’m constantly fighting against, **I refuse to take the easy way out, and our campaign doesn't take a dime of super PAC, fossil fuel, or corporate PAC money.**
I’ve been called “dumber than AOC” and “angry” by Josh Mandel. I’ve had Tim Ryan dismiss my campaign and refuse to take me seriously because he doesn’t believe that a candidate _like me_ could ever make it to the Senate.
I’ll never apologize for or change who I am, no matter how many times my corporate-backed opponents count me out. I KNOW I have the community behind me, and nothing they can do or say will take that away.
**Now, I need your help again.** We’re rapidly approaching our primary election day and we can’t afford to fall behind. We have to ramp up our outreach and efforts to get the word out if we have any chance at winning this seat and sending the first Black woman to the U.S. Senate from Ohio.

Judge Ketanji Brown Jackson has a long record of left-wing activism both on and off the bench. = ---|--- | | | | == | == In a crusade to force the Biden administration to reverse a policy that makes illegal immigrants wait in Mexico—rather than in the U.S.—for court hearings, legal aid groups have turned on the president as well as the migrants the government coerced them to help. body:
Jensen Can't Be Trusted | | | | [ ](https://michelle4mn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0e599d2cf739987622330d245&id=909e20bb83&e=9d6926af69)

| | | **[](https://michelle4mn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0e599d2cf739987622330d245&id=deb57ef62d&e=9d6926af69)

Why Did Scott Jensen Campaign for President Trump's Opponent in 2020?**

In October of 2020, Scott Jensen spoke at a rally for Libertarian candidate Jo Jorgenson. You can watch the rally for yourself [here. ](https://michelle4mn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0e599d2cf739987622330d245&id=6682b4e5e0&e=9d6926af69)

Now Jensen claims the reason he attended was "just because people think differently than us does not mean we shouldn't engage in conversations with them."

**[This must be why Jensen held a Town Hall with radical-left winger and anti-cop legislator John Thompson.](https://michelle4mn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0e599d2cf739987622330d245&id=5eaa82b5d4&e=9d6926af69)** You might remember Thompson was the **[candidate who protested in front of the home](https://michelle4mn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0e599d2cf739987622330d245&id=1ff5465f6a&e=9d6926af69)** of a police leader in Hugo **where he screamed at and berated children** while also saying **[_"we don't give a f*ck if they burn Hugo down."_](https://michelle4mn.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0e599d2cf739987622330d245&id=ccd8efaabe&e=9d6926af69)** But according to Scott Jensen, we can have conversations with people like that.

Why is Scott Jensen always running away from his record and actions? Rather than standing with us; Jensen has shown us time and time again he will campaign against us and our values.

**Scott Jensen can't be trusted to lead Minnesota.**

# ICYMI: Bill McSwain on 'This Week in Pennsylvania'
**West Chester, Pa.** **\-- ** Bill McSwain, Republican candidate for Governor, joined the ABC27 show 'This Week in Pennsylvania', which aired Sunday 2/27. In his conversation with host Dennis Owens, McSwain discussed his vision for Pennsylvania, why he's the only candidate who can beat Josh Shapiro, and his promise to restore law and order across the Commonwealth.

McSwain also emphasized his desire to be a Governor for all 67 counties, and reaffirmed his commitment to fighting government overreach, reducing the tax burden, and creating a business-friendly climate so that hardworking families can thrive.

Watch the full discussion below:

|

| **BACKGROUND: **

Appointed by President Trump, McSwain's record as US Attorney demonstrates his fierce defense of constitutional rights, dedication to upholding law and order, and history of putting criminals and corrupt politicians in jail. Prior to becoming an attorney, Bill served as a scout/sniper platoon commander in the U.S. Marine Corps. He was born in Philadelphia and raised in Chester County, where he lives today with his wife, Stephanie, and their four children. More information on McSwain's background and platform is available [here.](https://freedompapac.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b9af0aef3fa3167622552aedb&id=b755c55155&e=b1ec95759b)

body:
| | Hi team, Sorry for the late email, but what I’m about to share with you is really important. Dear Friend,
I'm back and what a first month it's been!
For those of you who may not know me, I'm Elliot Gault and I'm excited to once again serve as Executive Director of the New Hampshire Republican Party!
[**I'm excited to be back for another cycle after serving as Executive Director in 2020 where we shocked the county by being the ONLY STATE in the nation to flip our State House from Democrat to Republican. **](https://5wbjs096.r.us-east-1.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fnew-hampshire-gop%2Ffebruary-2022-general-donation/4/0100017f425417e1-a36634cd-70e8-4e6d-bc1f-b96122c43459-000000/jOddBNojpbfI2BX2X9lFMbunjrI=259)
I'm excited to be back to work at the NHGOP where we are looking forward to building on our historic gains once more this year. We're going to re-elect Governor Sununu, pick up even more seats in the State House and Senate, hold onto our majority on the Executive Council, and we're going to send Annie Kuster, Chris Pappas, and Maggie Hassan packing!

Peter, today I formally filed my paperwork to be on the ballot as candidate for the next Lieutenant Governor of Arkansas! It was a special day for my family, but also a historic day for Arkansans who have the chance to vote for the State’s first female Governor and Lt. Governor! I pray that one day my little girl looks back on this picture of her momma and will appreciate the significance of this momentous occasion.
[](https://leslierutledge.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=823c8070c1f32066f44b816e6&id=02447087c4&e=624a44d946)
As we get closer to the **Republican Primary Election on May 24th** , you are going to hear a lot of fiery political rhetoric from my political opponents to draw your attention away from my record of [accomplishments](https://leslierutledge.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=823c8070c1f32066f44b816e6&id=1eac400781&e=624a44d946) and the lack of theirs. However, if you were raised like me then you already know that actions speak louder than words and voters care much more about a candidate’s record not their rhetoric... I’m proud of what I’ve been able to accomplish on behalf of Arkansans and I encourage you go check out the “[**Rutledge Record**](https://leslierutledge.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=823c8070c1f32066f44b816e6&id=c4fd130b24&e=624a44d946) ” for yourself before you cast your vote.
[](https://leslierutledge.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=823c8070c1f32066f44b816e6&id=d590cc62be&e=624a44d946)
If you believe elected officials should take the _“a little less talk and a lot more action”_ approach to government, then I’m your girl! [But time is running out and I need your help now to finish this campaign strong!](https://leslierutledge.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=823c8070c1f32066f44b816e6&id=880aa97da9&e=624a44d946) Please consider [contributing to our campaign](https://leslierutledge.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=823c8070c1f32066f44b816e6&id=92f21ae3a4&e=624a44d946) before our monthly **deadline at 11:59pm tonight**!Thanks,
Leslie

I know it’s getting late, Peter. But I need to ask a favor.

This month, we’ve seen the cruelty of DeSantis and his GOP allies on full display. We’ve seen mounting pressure on Florida families and the total inaction of our supposed “Governor.”

And after a month like that, we need to come out swinging — fighting like hell to bring something new to Florida.

We only have a few hours left until our midnight deadline, and we’re still $4,387 short. So I’m personally asking — can you spare $5 to help us close the gap and come out of February ready to keep up the fight? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-feb-2022?refcode=eom8]

Florida families deserve a Governor who will fight for us — not take away our rights, silence our voices, and make our lives harder.

But that won’t happen unless we all stand together and put in the work. And with midnight just hours away, I’m asking you to stand with me tonight. If you can, please click here to chip in $5 and help us reach our goal. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-feb-2022?refcode=eom8]

With thanks,
Nikki

Do you think it’s possible that Democrats even believe the lies they’re promulgating anymore?

Probably because the mainstream media spoon feeds them information that they want to hear.

I’ve got the right credentials to serve in Congress. What I don’t have is money.

| _**ABOUT ROD**_

Rod Dorilás is the first-generation son of two immigrants from Haiti. His father immigrated to Florida to pick crops, and eventually his parents went on to own a small business. From a young age, his parents instilled in him the importance of hard work, integrity, and service.

At age 17, Rod enlisted in the United States Navy, serving for six years as a Petty Officer Second Class and Assistant Engagement Control Officer onboard the USS The Sullivans, stationed in Jacksonville. There, he was responsible for planning and executing the deployment of Tomahawk Land Attack Missiles on the Ballistic Missile Defense destroyer.

Upon completion of his military service, Rod attended law school at Syracuse University with the help of the G.I. Bill. After graduating, he served in President Trump's Administration in the U.S. Department of Commerce. While serving our great nation, Rod fought tirelessly to ensure that American families and businesses weren't taken advantage of by China.

Rod is a true public servant and is dedicated to serving his country and community. He wants to ensure that every American, through hard work and perseverance, can achieve the American Dream. Rod is running for Congress in South Florida to continue Trump's America First Agenda and defend our country from the Radical Left.

body:
This is your campaign and I will be your Lt. Governor. |
#
---
This race is personal for me, and I’ll tell you why. Texas is my home. I grew up here, and Suzanne and I raised our children here. Fighting for Texas is what I know best — it’s in my blood. I knew from the beginning that this race would be a challenge. I also knew this was a chance to give Texas a Lt. Governor who will fight alongside them in the trenches. It was too important to let pass by. I'm running for Lt. Governor because I can no longer bear to watch Dan Patrick destroy our beloved state. **We are a great state. We are great people. And we deserve so much better than Dan Patrick.** Serving as Lt. Governor offers a tremendous platform, opportunity, and responsibility to lead our state and our country forward. Dan Patrick sees it differently. He has gone after our public schools with a vengeance. He has failed to fix the damn grid. He stokes hate and division at every turn. Me? clean_body: We’re putting all hands on deck to help Jessica win BIG. | | | Peter, we know we’ve been emailing practically every day, but we promise it’s for good reason. Our election is TOMORROW — so we’re putting all hands on deck to help Jessica win BIG. Voters are turning their backs on Henry Cuellar since the FBI raided his home and are questioning if he’s fit to lead. But we can’t put our bets on winning solely because of this, especially since voting rights have been under attack for several months in Texas. We can’t let last-minute dirty tricks from the GOP become the difference between victory and defeat. If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: Thank you for your support. We couldn’t have gotten this far without you. — Team Cisneros | To give by check: PO Box 660 Laredo, TX 78042

Anything you can pitch in right now will help us get John’s powerful ad on the air.
#
**FIRST:** This morning, we announced the launch of our first-ever TV ad _No Place for Granted_ and asked for help raising **$100,000** to get it on the air across PA.
**THEN:** 2,384 of yinz stepped up with a donation. _That’s just today_. Grassroots power in action, y’all. **💪 💪 💪**
**NOW:** We still need to raise $58,512 toward our TV ad fund. Plus, tonight’s our end-of-month fundraising deadline, so we’re hoping to get as much of that as possible in the door before the clock strikes midnight.
**[Please, Derek, will you rush any amount you can spare to our campaign before midnight? This is a really, really important push for us.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/44976?refcode=em20220228-4786&t=1&akid=4786%2E434096%2EyiFUBp)**
**[Contribute $5](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/44976?amount=5&refcode=em20220228-4786&t=20&akid=4786%2E434096%2EyiFUBp)**
__
Anything you can pitch in right now will help us get John’s powerful ad on the air across all 67 PA counties → solidify our lead in the May primary → position John to flip this seat + head to Washington to fight for us as the Democrats’ 51st Senate vote.
Let’s get this done,
Team Fetterman
P.S. A wave of grassroots support to get our campaign’s message on the air will help us make up for a shorter-than-usual month of fundraising. (We didn’t even get Leap Day this year!) **[Can you chip in right away to help us hit our critical $100,000 goal before our end-of-month deadline at midnight?](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/44976?refcode=em20220228-4786&t=21&akid=4786%2E434096%2EyiFUBp)**

body:
I have about 15 minutes of free time in my schedule today. I know that doesn’t sound like an extraordinary amount of time
| [ ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/6623?t=6&akid=1384%2E878179%2EnjQ6R_) Friends —

I have about 15 minutes of free time in my schedule today. I know that doesn’t sound like a lot of time, but with a schedule like mine I can assure you it’s a gift.

I want to take a few of those minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place, and ask you to split a donation between my re-election campaign and Voter Protection Project. Your support is so important to our success.

The truth is, when Gabby and I first started talking about running, we weren’t sure what to expect. We knew that Arizona needed new leadership in the Senate — someone who would always put the people of our state first, who was willing to work across the aisle to deliver real results, and who would prioritize building bridges between parties — not burning them down.

We also knew we had some friends who would help us out. But when you’re talking about such a big campaign, we’d need support from a lot of people we hadn’t met yet as well. Especially since I was making the decision to reject corporate PAC money.

You know the rest... we won in 2020 in large part because we ran the biggest grassroots campaign Arizona has ever seen.

But now we have a new mission: Re‐election.

And right now, the polls are really tight. If we’re going to win again and keep control of the Senate, it’s going to take a similar level of grassroots support from people like you.

So please:

[Will you split a $5 contribution between my re-election campaign and Voter Protection Project? I know that doesn’t sound like a lot of time, but with a schedule like mine I can assure you it’s a gift. I want to take a few of those minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place, and ask you to split a donation between my re-election campaign and Voter Protection Project. Your support is so important to our success. The truth is, when Gabby and I first started talking about running, we weren’t sure what to expect. We knew that Arizona needed new leadership in the Senate — someone who would always put the people of our state first, who was willing to work across the aisle to deliver real results, and who would prioritize building bridges between parties — not burning them down. We also knew we had some friends who would help us out. But when you’re talking about such a big campaign, we’d need support from a lot of people we hadn’t met yet as well. Especially since I was making the decision to reject corporate PAC money. You know the rest... we won in 2020 in large part because we ran the biggest grassroots campaign Arizona has ever seen. But now we have a new mission: Re‐election. And right now, the polls are really tight. If we’re going to win again and keep control of the Senate, it’s going to take a similar level of grassroots support from people like you. Our 34th wedding anniversary

| Kevin and I were married in a civil ceremony on Leap Day in 1988 in Seoul City Hall in Korea, and later in the 2nd Infantry Division Chapel, surrounded by our fellow U.S. Army soldiers. Despite celebrating our 34th anniversary this year, we joke that technically it’s only been eight years.

Our anniversary this year is very special: Kevin is now home from his assignment with United States Agency for International Development (USAID) in Kenya. He served 49 years in the U.S. Army and USAID. We have been physically separated for many anniversaries and birthdays, yet our love and respect for one another have always grown through the hardships.

**[Would you sign our (virtual) card for Kevin, welcoming him home? I know it would mean the world to him to know you’re celebrating alongside us>>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42371825/332734269/1562790665?refcode=ea.31696595-e998-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.31696595-e998-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMTY5NjU5NS1lOTk4LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aCFWYkHYDdezJnmNEeWkC6rnQn3Z-I2FES__N-pPNYA=&emci=66ebb3a7-c898-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=31696595-e998-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=5944225)** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/42371826/332734270/1562790665?refcode=ea.31696595-e998-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.31696595-e998-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMTY5NjU5NS1lOTk4LWVjMTEtYTUwNy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aCFWYkHYDdezJnmNEeWkC6rnQn3Z-I2FES__N-pPNYA=&emci=66ebb3a7-c898-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&emdi=31696595-e998-ec11-a507-281878b83d8a&ceid=5944225) When Kevin and I met, we were both young officers and it was love at first sight.

We made a promise to each other, not unlike our commitments to our country and faith. We have raised our family with pride for America and its values, knowing these are lights for the free world. Through challenging assignments, we sometimes traded places as the single parent to our three children. I am proud to be married to Kevin, as we shouldered sacrifices for our family, our community, and our country.

Kevin has been my biggest inspiration in running for Congress. Today, he retired after 49 years of service to our government, and I am proud to have him by my side.

clean_body: Our 34th wedding anniversary | Kevin and I were married in a civil ceremony on Leap Day in 1988 in Seoul City Hall in Korea, and later in the 2nd Infantry Division Chapel, surrounded by our fellow U.S. Army soldiers. Despite celebrating our 34th anniversary this year, we joke that technically it’s only been eight years. Our anniversary this year is very special: Kevin is now home from his assignment with United States Agency for International Development (USAID) in Kenya. He served 49 years in the U.S. Army and USAID. We have been physically separated for many anniversaries and birthdays, yet our love and respect for one another have always grown through the hardships. When Kevin and I met, we were both young officers and it was love at first sight. We made a promise to each other, not unlike our commitments to our country and faith. We have raised our family with pride for America and its values, knowing these are lights for the free world. Through challenging assignments, we sometimes traded places as the single parent to our three children. I am proud to be married to Kevin, as we shouldered sacrifices for our family, our community, and our country. Kevin has been my biggest inspiration in running for Congress. Today, he retired after 49 years of service to our government, and I am proud to have him by my side. Thank you for all your support, Deb = | | Deb McGrath is an Army Veteran, former CIA officer, and mother of three running for Congress in WI-03. | | Dear Peter, **** As Washington continues to promote a potential war (this time with a nuclear-armed adversary!) I’m forced to observe the layers of corruption that enable this pattern of militarism to repeat itself yet again. [**Can you join us today to expand our efforts to expose that corruption, and offer an alternative to the voters otherwise poised to send a crucial architect of militarism back to Washington for the 19th term?**](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTCxhAMhTRXK4t_BbI_sQ5MJPjsw9QTL7VC2L8aK7NYeRnaz1ZDTd--gz483W0Y8bRYLbQT9unef_PRx23Ic5G2ix24Dx3kOxREiLHx7b5vQm2zgY0K7RZTOOMJPaPmdf9zZ3CKuBWzDMaat0LK7DU3XF0CKPsWaDBQ-Fg864MjQziSGGfGn7KB6h2YXif0lbBUoM_28VzezyVWtZgTn9w16V_8TQS9z5ulYCPgjuIqfUHDpa27mS7r-BAPLkqz0OCDk1dueJ5bnUZZ-ZK3r4nPeysgOfAox0iRT0u4J4bqOszBZVf-7CAy819V2BdjV5vQ/3jy/btuBhcLFSBK2zYYpmlSZJw/h1/SLXx_kdH5hDc0g_FZlMyEeo0B5DjU2Y-tkiifF00ymQ) The original reason I left non-profit advocacy to leap into the electoral arena was to challenge the institutional corruption of the military-industrial complex. I’ve been challenging it, from the streets to the halls of Congress and local legislatures across the country, for two decades. I grew tired of watching career politicians screw the pooch, mouthing oaths of office to a Constitution that they don’t even understand well enough to recognize when it’s under assault. Running against Pelosi offered the chance to more closely explore and examine her record, which reveals stunning complicity in the entrenchment of bipartisan militarism over the past generation. By actively funding everything from recurring wars-for-profit to concentration camps at our country’s borders, and helping cover up everything from CIA torture to NSA mass surveillance, Pelosi has helped lead the neutralization of the Democratic Party as a voice for global peace. [**Can you join us today to accelerate our efforts next month? Having held Pelosi accountable on multiple issues in 2020, we’re eager to force her hand again with your support.**](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTCxhAMhTRXK4t_BbI_sQ5MJPjsw9QTL7VC2L8aK7NYeRnaz1ZDTd--gz483W0Y8bRVqshnOkYoGHcho_zq0FKrg6E5X2Iwb6NyxkBo_RebFBX-3jDOJcEqNaSNCeNHJrFxx5JAe7BhUGdjNWcMlGEOLj-E7i3BNTrmXe44rQIVE5LXDynKrgO4x9hDt-foS9SAl_2xylSCoLxzDX1o3_VXmKK5buG1RXmM8evvRzdGpFvAcrbvK6qE39EVHDR8lQhpWiALf6bb6rREPt9VsbCAWOituKa-XsGYJ0ZQOrpPONaC-MOHsGSOSFs3XghEqoPA/3jy/btuBhcLFSBK2zYYpmlSZJw/h2/DZu6CcwjS2OeALFUMPVIER6b_iatqlCREXuy5lDhR48) Pelosi’s role enabling the institutional corruption of Washington’s military-industrial complex is the tip of an iceberg. Remember: this is a figure born into a political dynasty who has amassed a private fortune worth over $200 million, at least in part through targeted self-serving tax breaks, personally benefiting from government economic relief programs intended for those less fortunate, and insider trading. In other words, the institutional corruption of the Pentagon relies on a figure whose individual corruption insulates it. When I ran against Pelosi in 2020, I discovered that the party patronage network supporting Pelosi is as corrupt as the institutional establishment that she protects in Washington. An article published just last weekend publicly exposed new layers of the disinformation orchestrated by Democratic Party climbers to insulate Pelosi. We’re working tirelessly to defend election integrity, fend off disinformation from across the political spectrum, and hold accountable a powerful oligarch. ---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Charles Booker [info@e.charlesbooker.org]
Date: Mon, Feb 28, 2022 at 1:00 PM
Subject: I want to share a story,
Peter.
To: Peter [dpwillis67@gmail.com]

Hi Peter,

My team told me we’re just $3,892 short of hitting our February
fundraising goal.

They suggested I reach out and tell you why you should chip in to our
campaign before the deadline tonight.

So I’m going to share my story with you. It’s important that you know why
I jumped into this fight to defeat Rand Paul if I’m going to ask you to
give whatever you can to support our grassroots movement.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220228-2?refcode=em20220228-1612&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&refcode2=1612_346206_JCYd_t&akid=1612%2E346206%2EJCYd_t ]When you finish reading, will you chip in $5 to our
grassroots campaign and help us hit our critical $50,000 fundraising goal
tonight? We’re relying on donations from emails like this to power our
people-first campaign.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220228-2?refcode=em20220228-1612&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1005&refcode2=1612_346206_JCYd_t&akid=1612%2E346206%2EJCYd_t ]Chip in to defeat Rand Paul and read my story →

Peter, I grew
up in one of the poorest ZIP codes in Kentucky. Both of my parents had to
drop out of high school to help take care of my brothers and sisters. We
sometimes had to go without heat in the winter or air conditioning in the
summer. My mom often went without eating so that I could.

But my family wasn’t alone in their struggles.

We’re just a single example of the thousands of families in Kentucky
who’ve been left behind by politicians who have used their power to only
benefit themselves.

So I got involved in public service because I believed Kentuckians
deserved better and that things could get better. I became the youngest
Black legislator in Kentucky in 90 years. I ran for Senate in 2020 against
Mitch McConnell and everyone in the media started to talk about what we
were building in Kentucky.

I see progress happening — but I know there’s still a lot of work ahead of
us to transform the future of Kentucky.

So now, we’re taking our movement to Rand Paul. From the deadly COVID
misinformation he’s been spreading, his refusal to pass anti-lynching
legislation, and the record number of bills he’s proudly blocked that
would lift up working families in Kentucky — it’s clear that Rand isn’t in
the Senate to help us.

He’s there to help himself and make a quick buck with his influence in the
Senate.

I’m done with this cycle of failed leadership — that’s why I’m running for
U.S. Senate,
Peter. I know what it’s like to
choose between affording insulin or groceries, to struggle to make ends
meet. My family taught me to take care of our neighbors. And my promise is
to bring these lived experiences to the U.S. Senate so we can finally pass
the urgent policies our families need.

Our campaign’s momentum is on the rise — but it’s critical we reach our
fundraising goal tonight so we can continue spreading our message to every
corner of Kentucky and grow this grassroots movement. [ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220228-2?refcode=em20220228-1612&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1025&refcode2=1612_346206_JCYd_t&akid=1612%2E346206%2EJCYd_t ]Will you chip
in $5 or anything you can to help close the gap before
midnight tonight?

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-20220228-2?refcode=em20220228-1612&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1026&refcode2=1612_346206_JCYd_t&akid=1612%2E346206%2EJCYd_t ]Contribute $5

Thanks for reading my story. I hope it moved you to chip in.

Charles

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:

#

Hi there,
Our February end-of-month fundraising deadline is tonight at midnight, so we wanted to take a minute to share why these deadlines are so important to our success.
We’ll explain more in a minute, but if you’re ready, we hope you’ll consider [**making a $5 donation today to help us keep building our grassroots movement all across California.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-feb22?refcode=em220228-1-60&t=1&refcode2=666_159979_v0ZGA7&akid=666%2E159979%2Ev0ZGA7)
**[DONATE](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-feb22?refcode=em220228-1-60&t=2&refcode2=666_159979_v0ZGA7&akid=666%2E159979%2Ev0ZGA7)**
Alright, here’s the deal: as of this morning, we’re still short of our goal for February.
And hitting our marks each month is critical, especially in an election year, because it allows us to continue building support for progressive policies like the Green New Deal and comprehensive immigration reform, and it also prevents us from having to play catch-up later down the road.
More importantly, it allows Alex to focus on strengthening our movement and keeping up the important work he’s doing in the Senate.
This has always been a grassroots movement right from the start. And what that means is instead of relying on dark money or checks from special interest groups, Alex counts on lots and lots of people chipping in what they can when they can.
**$5 might not seem like much compared to the obscene sums of dark money in politics these days, but when you chip in $5 and someone else does as well, it all adds up quickly.**
[**Will you make a $5 contribution to our grassroots campaign? We’ve got so much work to do in the coming months, and every donation sends a powerful message that we will not back down without a fight.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-feb22?refcode=em220228-1-60&t=3&refcode2=666_159979_v0ZGA7&akid=666%2E159979%2Ev0ZGA7)
It’s supporters like you that are so crucial to our campaign. Thank you for everything you do — it means so much to Alex to be alongside you in the fight.
Team Padilla

clean_body: | | | | Wyoming deserves better than this. | Peter, These are the FINAL hours before our End-of-Month Fundraising Deadline. Harriet is a fighter, and she’s given her all to this battle to save Wyoming from Liz Cheney and the uni-party in DC, but without patriots like you, we won’t be able to hit our fundraising goal, less than 48 hours away. This election is in the hands of the people. It’s up to you to step up and protect Wyoming. As an attorney who has battled the unaccountable bureaucrats for decades, Harriet is tough, and she knows what it takes to go up against the most entrenched career politicians in the country. That’s what makes her so prepared to represent you. She isn’t relying on the establishment, and she isn’t relying on big-dollar donors -- she’s simply working hard to get the job done HERSELF. Right now, America needs a leader like Harriet. A tough and bold, strong woman to take on the corruption and obstruction plaguing our Nation every day. She’s fighting hard, she’s ready to win, now she just needs you to step up, and help her crush her End-of-Month fundraising goal. Thank you, Team Hageman | | | |
